title_cn: GUIAuditor：基于动作引导 GUI 溯源的移动设备儿童安全事后取证
abstract_cn: 智能设备的普及使儿童暴露于深度嵌入合法应用的线上风险（如诱骗与金融诈骗）之中。当前方法依赖自动预防与检测，而这一范式受其固有错误倾向的根本限制：无论基于规则还是 AI 驱动，都不可避免地产生误报与漏报，无法提供可靠保护。本文主张一种互补的、人在回路的、事后取证范式。我们提出 GUIAuditor——首个实现该愿景的系统——通过创建 GUI 溯源实现：一种可查询的、语义化的儿童交互序列记录。GUIAuditor 利用多模态大模型（MLLM）把 GUI 事件的时间序列翻译为人类可理解的叙述。为使其在移动设备上实用，新颖的证据蒸馏流水线把需要分析的数据量较业界标准采用的周期采样方法减少 89.2% 以上，且对精度影响可忽略。在 295 个交互片段的新数据集上，GUIAuditor 在记录重要事件上取得 95.23% 的 Macro-F1，且其两阶段取证查询引擎对 90.20% 以上的自然语言问题成功将正确证据排为首位。在三部现代智能手机上的端到端评估显示，包括设备端 MLLM 推理在内的完整流水线增加 2.1W 功耗与每事件 7.4 秒延迟，峰值内存约 3.1GB。这些结果表明，事后 GUI 取证可在现代移动设备上运行，并为监护人主导的安全审查提供有用语境。
summary_cn: GUIAuditor 首创儿童安全事后取证：MLLM 把 GUI 事件序列转为可查询叙述，证据蒸馏减少 89.2% 分析数据；295 片段上 Macro-F1 95.23%、取证问答 top-1 命中 90.20%+，真机功耗 +2.1W。IMWUT 2026 录用。
objective_summary: 提出以 GUI 溯源为核心的事后取证系统 GUIAuditor：MLLM 叙述化交互序列、证据蒸馏降载、两阶段查询引擎支持自然语言取证，并在新数据集与三部真机上评估精度、检索与资源开销。
evidence_note: IMWUT/Ubicomp 2026 录用；295 片段数据集、精度/检索/资源三层量化，三部现代手机端到端实测功耗、延迟与内存。
novelty_note: 首个面向儿童安全的事后 GUI 取证系统与「GUI 溯源」表示，把防护范式从预防检测转向人在回路的事后审查。
scope: 结论适用于可采集 GUI 事件的现代智能手机与家长监护场景；对 iOS 等封闭平台、规避性使用（权限关闭、多设备切换）未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖监护人主动审查，事后范式无法实时阻止伤害；MLLM 叙述可能遗漏或曲解上下文；被监护人行为被完整记录本身引入隐私风险。

title: Safety-Aware Zero Trust Enforcement for IoT and Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: Zero Trust (ZT) replaces the implicit trust of perimeter-based security with explicit, continuous, context-aware authorization. This shift is particularly relevant to IoT and cyber-physical systems, whose heterogeneous, long-lived, and remotely connected components make persistent trust untenable. Yet their physical coupling complicates ZT adoption: restricting a suspicious component can reduce cyber exposure while removing telemetry or control capabilities required for operation. Existing work mainly models physical harm caused by attacks, with less attention to consequences introduced by enforcement itself. We introduce Safety-Aware Zero Trust (SA-ZT), which treats restriction-induced physical consequences as policy inputs. We map the NIST ZT tenets to nine IoT/CPS convergence strains, distinguish IoT-amplified challenges from those specific to cyber-physical coupling, and derive corresponding operational requirements. SA-ZT extends the NIST ZT Architecture with a Safety Engine and a Telemetry Broker. The Safety Engine selects among admissible responses by jointly considering residual cyber risk and restriction-induced consequences, while the Telemetry Broker mediates raw telemetry visibility and estimator influence. With command-side enforcement, these entities separate raw visibility, automated influence, and state-changing authority, preserving observations for monitoring while constraining their influence on automated control. An IEEE 30-bus case study under false-data-injection attack illustrates how SA-ZT makes cyber containment, telemetry visibility and influence, physical consequences, and authorization timing explicit, providing an implementable and inspectable representation of cyber-physical enforcement trade-offs.
title_cn: 面向 IoT 与信息物理系统的安全感知零信任执行
abstract_cn: 零信任（ZT）以显式、持续、情境感知的授权取代边界安全的隐式信任。这一转变对 IoT 与信息物理系统（CPS）尤具意义：其异构、长寿、远程连接的组件使持久信任难以为继。然而物理耦合使 ZT 采用复杂化：限制一个可疑组件可以减少网络暴露，但也会移除运行所需的遥测或控制能力。现有工作主要建模攻击造成的物理伤害，对执法本身引入的后果关注较少。我们提出安全感知零信任（SA-ZT），把限制引发的物理后果作为策略输入。我们将 NIST ZT 原则映射到九种 IoT/CPS 融合压力，区分被 IoT 放大的挑战与信息物理耦合特有的挑战，并推导相应的运营要求。SA-ZT 用安全引擎与遥测代理扩展 NIST ZT 架构：安全引擎在联合考虑残余网络风险与限制后果的前提下在许可响应中选择；遥测代理中介原始遥测的可见性与估计器影响。借助命令侧执行，这两个实体把原始可见性、自动化影响与状态变更权限分离，在为监控保留观测的同时约束其对自动控制的影响。IEEE 30 节点总线在虚假数据注入攻击下的案例研究展示 SA-ZT 如何使网络遏制、遥测可见性与影响、物理后果和授权时机显式化，为信息物理执行权衡提供可实施、可审查的表示。
summary_cn: 提出把「限制引发的物理后果」纳入策略输入的安全感知零信任 SA-ZT：以安全引擎与遥测代理扩展 NIST 架构，分离可见性、影响与变更权限；IEEE 30 总线虚假数据注入案例研究展示执行权衡。
objective_summary: 针对 ZT 执法在 CPS 中可能损害物理运行的矛盾，提出以物理后果为策略输入的 SA-ZT 框架，映射 NIST 原则到九类融合压力并以安全引擎、遥测代理实现，在 IEEE 30 节点总线上做案例演示。
evidence_note: 概念框架+单一 IEEE 30 节点总线案例演示，无系统性实验、对比基线或真实系统部署。
novelty_note: 零信任研究多关注攻击后果，本文新意在把「执法自身引发的物理后果」显式建模为授权输入并给出可审查的执行结构。
scope: 结论适用于具有物理耦合与遥测依赖的 IoT/CPS 域（案例为电网）；对无物理后果的纯 IT 系统与其他 CPS 领域的直接迁移未验证。
limitations: 仅一个 IEEE 30 总线案例，未覆盖多域与攻击组合；物理后果建模依赖预设的许可响应集合；安全引擎决策的实时性未评估。

title: No Place to Hide: An Analysis on Protected Order Flow Sandwich Attacks
abstract: Front-running has long plagued Ethereum's public mempool, earning it the nickname of a "dark forest", where predators lurk for profitable transactions. In response, Ethereum and other blockchain ecosystems increasingly rely on private RPCs and native protections to shield transactions from adversaries, which we refer to as protected order flow. Yet the effectiveness of these mechanisms in preventing front-running, and what trust assumptions they entail, remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct the first longitudinal, three-year measurement study of sandwich attacks against protected order flow across six blockchains: Ethereum, Solana, Tron, Base, Arbitrum, and Monad. We introduce detection heuristics that capture wide attacks, both within and across blocks, and filter on bot behavior to distinguish sandwiches from legitimate trading activity. We identify 28.0 million sandwich attacks on Solana, 38,567 on Tron, 30,607 on Ethereum, and 1,889 on Base against transactions intended to be protected from front-running. Reorged blocks expose a further 2,875 Ethereum victims. Unlike conventional public-mempool sandwiches, these attacks rarely occur tightly around their victims and, outside Solana, are carried out by a small number of entities. Our analysis uncovers exposures at every layer: validator- and application-level exposure on Solana, order-flow auctions and reorged blocks on Ethereum, first-come-first-served ordering that fails to prevent latency-based front-running on Tron, and both an RPC bug that exposes pending transactions and predictable victim behavior on Base. These findings show that existing front-running protections can provide substantially weaker guarantees than users expect, highlighting the need for stronger end-to-end defenses against sandwich attacks.
title_cn: 无处可藏：受保护订单流三明治攻击分析
abstract_cn: 抢跑长期困扰以太坊公开内存池，使其得名「黑暗森林」——捕食者潜伏等待有利可图的交易。为此，以太坊及其他区块链生态日益依赖私有 RPC 与原生保护来屏蔽交易免受对手窥探，我们称之为受保护订单流。然而这些机制在防止抢跑上的实效及其信任假设仍缺乏理解。本工作对六条区块链——以太坊、Solana、Tron、Base、Arbitrum 与 Monad——上针对受保护订单流的三明治攻击进行了首个为期三年的纵向测量研究。我们引入能捕捉块内与跨块宽泛攻击的检测启发式，并按机器人行为过滤以区分三明治与正常交易活动。我们识别出 Solana 上 2,800 万次、Tron 上 38,567 次、以太坊上 30,607 次、Base 上 1,889 次针对本应受抢跑保护交易的三明治攻击；重组区块还暴露了另外 2,875 名以太坊受害者。与传统公开内存池三明治不同，这些攻击很少紧贴受害者发生，且在 Solana 之外由少数实体实施。我们的分析揭示每一层都有暴露面：Solana 的验证者与应用层暴露，以太坊的订单流拍卖与重组区块，Tron 上未能阻止基于延迟抢跑的先到先得排序，Base 上暴露待处理交易的 RPC 缺陷与可预测的受害者行为。这些发现表明，现有抢跑保护所能提供的保证远弱于用户预期，凸显了对三明治攻击建立更强端到端防御的需要。
summary_cn: 首个对六条链受保护订单流三明治攻击的三年纵向测量：Solana 2,800 万次、以太坊 30,607 次、Tron 38,567 次、Base 1,889 次，揭示验证者、拍卖与 RPC 等多层暴露面，现有保护远弱于预期。
objective_summary: 提出覆盖块内/跨块与机器人行为过滤的三明治检测启发式，对六条区块链三年内针对受保护订单流的三明治攻击做纵向测量，量化规模、行为特征与各层暴露面。
evidence_note: 三年期、六条链、在野 2,800 万级攻击样本，检测启发式按机器人行为过滤并跨链对比行为模式，纵向数据规模大。
novelty_note: 首个针对「受保护订单流」被三明治的系统性纵向测量，逐一揭示四条链不同机制的暴露面，修正「私有 RPC 即安全」的普遍预期。
scope: 结论适用于六条被测链与测量窗口内的三明治生态；对攻击者策略演化后的新形态与其他链未覆盖，检测启发式可能漏报。
limitations: 基于启发式检测，存在漏报/误报且未给出人工标注的金标准评估；受害者损失金额未量化；Arbitrum 与 Monad 上攻击量级较小、结论较弱。

title: Your Model Is Leaking: Covert Information Transfer through LLM Residual Streams
abstract: Privacy-sensitive organizations may run large language models (LLMs) in restricted or air-gapped environments while exporting selected diagnostic artifacts. We show that a compromised runtime component can hide sensitive information in intermediate activations that are allowed to leave the restricted environment. An offline observer can recover this information with a simple linear decoder. The attack requires no model retraining or weight modification, no attacker-controlled egress, and no control over the recorder or transfer process. We introduce a residual-stream covert-channel attack that maps messages to codewords and injects them into an intermediate residual stream through a compromised runtime hook. To maintain recoverability, the injection strength is scaled with the local residual norm using the signal-to-residual-norm ratio. Across eleven models from seven architecture families, our evaluation shows 91--100% recovery on nine models with KL divergence 0.001--0.007, while evaluated activation-level detectors remain close to random guessing (AUC <= 0.56). Tested post-hoc defenses do not reliably eliminate the channel. Thus, an activation artifact can be schema-valid while carrying information that is not authorized to cross the boundary.
title_cn: 你的模型在泄密：经由 LLM 残差流的隐蔽信息传输
abstract_cn: 隐私敏感的组织可能在受限或气隙环境中运行大语言模型（LLM），同时导出选定的诊断工件。我们证明：一个被攻陷的运行时组件可以把敏感信息隐藏在允许离开受限环境的中间激活中，而离线观察者用简单的线性解码器即可恢复。该攻击不需要重训模型或修改权重、不需要攻击者控制的出口信道、也不需要控制记录器或传输过程。我们提出一种残差流隐蔽信道攻击：把消息映射为码字，经被攻陷的运行时钩子注入中间残差流；为保持可恢复性，注入强度按局部残差范数以信号-残差范数比缩放。在来自七个架构家族的十一个模型上的评估显示：九个模型上恢复率达 91–100%，KL 散度 0.001–0.007，而已评估的激活级检测器接近随机猜测（AUC ≤ 0.56）；经测试的事后防御无法可靠消除该信道。因此，一个符合模式的激活工件可以在合法格式之下携带未经授权跨越边界的信息。
summary_cn: 揭示残差流隐蔽信道：被攻陷运行时钩子按范数比把码字注入中间激活，线性解码即可恢复；七个家族 11 个模型中 9 个恢复率 91–100%、KL 仅 0.001–0.007，检测器 AUC ≤ 0.56 且事后防御无效。
objective_summary: 提出针对受限环境 LLM 导出激活工件的隐蔽信道攻击：运行时钩子注入按范数缩放的码字，无需改权重或额外出口，并在 11 个模型上量化恢复率、输出扰动、检测与防御效果。
evidence_note: 七个架构家族 11 个模型、恢复率/KL/检测 AUC 多指标量化并评估事后防御，系统性广；无统计检验与真实组织环境案例。
novelty_note: 首次把「导出的激活工件」确立为不需要网络出口的隐蔽外传介质，并给出按范数自适应缩放的可靠编码机制。
scope: 结论适用于导出中间激活/诊断工件的 LLM 部署与被攻陷运行时组件威胁模型；对仅导出最终输出或不导出任何激活的部署不适用。
limitations: 需要运行时钩子这一较强前提；11 个模型中仅 9 个报告高恢复率，暗示架构依赖；对更强的激活审计与形式化防御未评估。

title: Enhancing Multiclass Malware Classification in Resource-Constrained Environments
abstract: The emergence of multi-class malware attacks such as ransomware, spyware, trojans, etc., presents an increasing and serious threat to cybersecurity, particularly in resourceconstrained environments like IoT devices. Existing machine learning models have achieved nearly perfect accuracy in binary malware classification but fall short in terms of classifying malware families and individual malware. Additionally, the complexity of these multi-class malware attacks presents a significant challenge of detection in resource-constrained environments, as multi-class detection usually requires high computational capability. This research bridges the gap by enhancing the detection accuracy of multi-class malware classification as well as developing a lightweight model that can run efficiently on resource-constrained devices. In this paper, we propose a robust, lightweight machine learning model featuring LightGBM classifier with SMOTE oversampling and SOM-US undersampling techniques for data balancing, as well as well-engineered feature selection through Genetic Algorithm. The model performed better than the current state-of-the-art models developed on the same dataset in both malware family classification (4 classes) and individual malware type classification (16 classes) with accuracy of 89.1% and 76% respectively. Thus, maintaining a balance between classification accuracy and computational efficiency in resource-constrained environments. Furthermore, we propose another model using Random Forest classifier with an accuracy of 91.2% in malware family classification and 78.7% in individual malware classification. Demonstrating a significant enhancement in terms of accuracy from the current state-of-the-art models.
title_cn: 资源受限环境下多类恶意软件分类的增强
abstract_cn: 勒索软件、间谍软件、木马等多类恶意软件攻击对网络安全构成日益严重的威胁，尤其是在 IoT 设备等资源受限环境中。现有机器学习模型在二分类恶意软件检测上已接近完美，但在恶意软件家族与个体恶意软件分类上仍显不足。多类攻击的复杂性使资源受限环境下的检测更具挑战，因为多类检测通常需要较高算力。本研究通过提升多类恶意软件分类准确率并开发可在资源受限设备上高效运行的轻量模型来弥合该差距。本文提出一个鲁棒的轻量级机器学习模型：以 LightGBM 分类器配合 SMOTE 过采样与 SOM-US 欠采样做数据均衡，并通过遗传算法进行精细特征选择。该模型相对在同一数据集上开发的现有最先进模型，在恶意软件家族分类（4 类）与个体恶意软件分类（16 类）上分别取得 89.1% 与 76% 的准确率，在资源受限环境中兼顾分类准确率与计算效率。此外我们提出另一个使用随机森林分类器的模型，家族分类准确率 91.2%、个体分类 78.7%，相对现有最先进模型展示出显著提升。
summary_cn: 提出 LightGBM+SMOTE/SOM-US+遗传算法特征选择的轻量多类恶意软件分类模型：4 类家族 89.1%、16 类个体 76%，随机森林变体分别达 91.2% 与 78.7%，均超同数据集已有 SOTA。
objective_summary: 面向资源受限环境的多类恶意软件分类，构建 LightGBM/随机森林配合过采样、欠采样与遗传算法特征选择的轻量模型，并在家族（4 类）与个体（16 类）两档分类任务上与同数据集 SOTA 比较。
evidence_note: 与同数据集上已发表的 SOTA 模型对比并报告 4 类/16 类两档准确率，方法组件可复现；但无统计检验，数据集与划分细节未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 梯度提升+重采样+进化特征选择均为成熟组件，贡献是工程组合与资源受限适配，方法层面无新机制。
scope: 结论适用于所用数据集覆盖的恶意软件家族集合与轻量级部署场景；对跨年新家族、加壳混淆与对抗样本未验证。
limitations: 16 类个体分类 76% 的绝对水平仍有限；重采样与特征选择引入的过拟合风险未充分讨论；与深度基线的算力对比不完整。

title: Shedding Light on Complex Bitcoin Mixer Transactions: 67-Fold Reduction in Unclassified Cases
abstract: Bitcoin's Unspent Transaction Output (UTXO) model enables public analysis of fund flows, but users often merge transactions into Shared Send Mixers (SSMs) to obscure these flows. Untangling SSMs to recover original subtransactions is an NP-complete problem. While a practical untangling algorithm exists, it fails to classify 1.4% of SSM transactions due to computational time limits. This paper introduces four novel heuristics that exploit structural weaknesses in real-world SSM transactions to resolve these timeout cases: preemptive grouping, connectable singleton, ambiguous pairing, and knapsack fallback. We provide theoretical proofs validating each heuristic and integrate them into an optimized pipeline. Applied to timeout transactions, our approach classifies 98.5% of previously unresolved cases, reducing the overall unclassified transaction rate from 1.4% to 0.021% of all SSM transactions. Our open-source implementation and comprehensive evaluation on the complete Bitcoin blockchain demonstrate that the heuristics effectively untangle previously intractable transactions, enabling more accurate flow analysis and deeper structural insights into cryptocurrency transaction patterns.
title_cn: 破解复杂的比特币混币交易：未分类案例降低 67 倍
abstract_cn: 比特币的未花费交易输出（UTXO）模型使资金流的公开分析成为可能，但用户常把交易合并进共享发送混币器（SSM）以掩盖这些流向。解开 SSM 以恢复原始子交易是 NP 完全问题。虽然已有实用解缠算法，但因计算时间限制仍有 1.4% 的 SSM 交易无法分类。本文提出四种利用真实世界 SSM 交易结构弱点的新启发式：预分组、可连接单例、歧义配对与背包回退。我们为每个启发式提供理论证明，并将其集成进优化流水线。应用于超时交易，该方法分类了此前未解决案例的 98.5%，把整体未分类交易率从全部 SSM 交易的 1.4% 降至 0.021%。我们的开源实现及在完整比特币区块链上的全面评估表明，这些启发式能有效解开此前难以处理的交易，实现更准确的流分析与对比特币交易模式更深入的结构洞察。
summary_cn: 提出四种启发式（预分组、可连接单例、歧义配对、背包回退）并附理论证明，解决共享发送混币器解缠的超时案例：98.5% 的超时案例被成功分类，整体未分类率从 1.4% 降至 0.021%；全链评估、实现开源。
objective_summary: 针对 SSM 解缠算法因超时遗留 1.4% 未分类交易的问题，提出四种带理论证明的结构启发式并集成进优化流水线，在完整比特币区块链上评估分类率并开源实现。
evidence_note: 在完整比特币区块链上评估、每个启发式附理论证明、实现开源；未分类率 1.4%→0.021% 的量化结果基于全量数据。
novelty_note: 在已有解缠算法框架内新增四条利用真实交易结构弱点的启发式并给出证明，属对既有问题的实质性算法补全而非新问题。
scope: 结论适用于真实世界 SSM 交易的结构弱点假设成立范围；对刻意规避这些弱点的混币方案与协议级隐私改进未覆盖。
limitations: 启发式依赖真实交易的结构性弱点，对抗性设计可使其失效；正确性证明针对启发式前提，误分类的下游影响未量化。

title: ChronosAttack: Adversarial Tool Scheduling Attacks on LLM Agents
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents often process external tool responses as they arrive, making response timing part of the decision process. We introduce ChronosAttack, a delay-only scheduling attack that changes when authentic tool responses arrive without modifying, adding, removing, or accelerating them. Bounded delays can change the order of the same evidence and alter the final decision. We evaluate ChronosAttack on GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.6 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude show strong targeted shifts in vulnerable settings, Gemini shows large shifts in the opposite direction, and DeepSeek is more stable under the tested schedules. We also find that sequential agent state is not always required and that a single scheduling inversion can cause a large decision change. Synchronization and order-consistency defenses reduce attacker control over observation order. These results show that tool-response timing can itself form an attack surface in asynchronous LLM agents.
title_cn: ChronosAttack：针对 LLM 智能体的对抗性工具调度攻击
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体常在工具响应到达时即行处理，使响应时序成为决策过程的一部分。我们提出 ChronosAttack，一种仅改变真实工具响应到达时机的延迟调度攻击：不修改、不添加、不删除、也不加速任何响应。有界延迟即可改变同一批证据的顺序并改变最终决策。我们在 GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.6 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash 与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 上评估 ChronosAttack：GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude 在易感设定下表现出强定向偏移，Gemini 出现大幅反向偏移，DeepSeek 在受测调度下更稳定。我们还发现顺序化的智能体状态并非总是必要，单次调度反转即可引起大幅决策改变。同步与顺序一致性防御可降低攻击者对观测顺序的控制。这些结果表明，工具响应时序本身可在异步 LLM 智能体中构成攻击面。
summary_cn: 提出 ChronosAttack：仅用有界延迟改变真实工具响应到达顺序即可翻转 LLM 智能体决策；GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude 出现强定向偏移、DeepSeek 较稳定，单次调度反转即可大幅改变决策；同步类防御可缓解。
objective_summary: 提出不修改内容的工具响应延迟调度攻击 ChronosAttack，在四个前沿 LLM 上测量观测顺序扰动对最终决策的影响，并评估同步与顺序一致性防御的效果。
evidence_note: 在四个前沿模型上做受控调度实验并覆盖正反向效应与防御评估，但无统计检验与多次运行方差报告，易感条件刻画较粗。
novelty_note: 开辟「响应时序本身即攻击面」的新威胁模型：不触碰响应内容、仅靠延迟重排证据即可改变决策，与提示注入类攻击机制截然不同。
scope: 结论适用于按到达顺序处理工具响应的异步智能体框架；对全局重排序、批处理聚合或带时间戳校验的架构适用性未验证。
limitations: 攻击效果强依赖模型与设定，Gemini 呈反向偏移说明可利用性不稳定；调度窗口受现实系统延迟分布约束；防御评估仅限同步类手段。

title: Agentic AI Cybersecurity Framework
abstract: The increasing scale, complexity, and dynamism of modern cyber threats have rendered traditional reactive cybersecurity mechanisms insufficient. This paper introduces an Agentic AI Cybersecurity Framework (AACF) designed to enable autonomous, goal-driven, and adaptive cyber defense operations. Unlike conventional systems that rely on predefined rules and human intervention, the proposed framework leverages agentic artificial intelligence to perceive environmental states, reason about potential threats, and execute context-aware responses with minimal supervision. The framework is structured into key functional layers, including perception, reasoning, decisionmaking, action execution, and feedback-driven learning, enabling continuous adaptation to evolving attack patterns. By integrating intelligent agents with real-time data analysis and automated response mechanisms, AACF supports proactive threat detection, dynamic risk assessment, and coordinated mitigation strategies across distributed environments. A conceptual architecture is presented, along with illustrative use cases demonstrating its applicability to intrusion detection, incident response, and autonomous security orchestration. The proposed framework contributes to the emerging paradigm of self-directed cybersecurity systems and provides a foundation for developing resilient, scalable, and intelligent defense infrastructures.
title_cn: 智能体式 AI 网络安全框架
abstract_cn: 现代网络威胁的规模、复杂性与动态性已使传统被动式网络安全机制不足。本文提出智能体式 AI 网络安全框架（AACF），旨在支持自主、目标驱动、自适应的网络防御运营。与依赖预定义规则和人工干预的传统系统不同，该框架利用智能体式人工智能感知环境状态、推理潜在威胁并以最少监督执行情境感知的响应。框架划分为关键功能层，包括感知、推理、决策、动作执行与反馈驱动学习，实现对不断演化攻击模式的持续适应。通过将智能体与实时数据分析和自动响应机制结合，AACF 支持主动威胁检测、动态风险评估与跨分布式环境的协同缓解策略。本文给出概念架构及展示其在入侵检测、事件响应与自主安全编排方面适用性的示例用例。该框架为自主网络安全系统的新兴范式做出贡献，并为开发有韧性、可扩展、智能的防御基础设施提供基础。
summary_cn: 提出智能体式网络安全框架 AACF 的概念架构：感知、推理、决策、执行与反馈学习五层，支持自主威胁检测与协同响应；给出入侵检测与事件响应示例用例，无实现或实验评估。
objective_summary: 提出面向自主网络防御的智能体式框架 AACF，描述感知、推理、决策、执行与反馈学习五个功能层的概念架构及入侵检测、事件响应等用例。
evidence_note: 纯概念架构与说明性用例，无实现、实验或与现有系统的对比验证。
novelty_note: 智能体式自主防御的分层架构与已有 agentic 安全框架构想高度相似，未提出新机制或新方法。
scope: 结论停留在框架设计层面，可作为自主防御系统的设计讨论基础；不构成对任何具体环境有效性的证据。
limitations: 无实现与评估；对智能体误判、被诱导与责任归属等风险未分析；与现有 SOAR/EDR 系统的关系未讨论。

title: Security and Privacy in Large-Model-Driven Embodied Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Future Directions
abstract: Large-model-driven embodied agents integrate foundation models with perception, reasoning, planning, and physical action, extending conventional model-level risks into embodied closed loops. Existing studies on their security and privacy remain fragmented across different system components and operational stages, making it difficult to understand how risks arise, propagate, and ultimately affect physical behavior or sensitive information. This survey presents a lifecycle-based analysis of security and privacy in large-model-driven embodied agents. We organize existing research into five stages: model construction and supply chain, multimodal input and interaction, semantic reasoning and task planning, action execution and physical feedback, and long-term deployment. Within this lifecycle, we systematically review representative attacks, defenses, and evaluation methods. Our analysis shows that attack entry, consequence realization, and defense intervention often occur at different stages of the embodied closed loop. It further reveals substantial gaps in end-to-end protection, real-world evaluation, and long-term privacy governance. This survey provides a unified perspective for understanding current progress and identifying critical directions for securing large-model-driven embodied agents.
title_cn: 大模型驱动的具身智能体安全与隐私：攻击、防御与未来方向
abstract_cn: 大模型驱动的具身智能体将基础模型与感知、推理、规划和物理动作结合，把传统模型层风险延伸到具身闭环中。现有关于其安全与隐私的研究分散在不同系统组件与运行阶段，难以理解风险如何产生、传播并最终影响物理行为或敏感信息。本综述对大模型驱动具身智能体的安全与隐私进行基于生命周期的分析：我们把现有研究组织为五个阶段——模型构建与供应链、多模态输入与交互、语义推理与任务规划、动作执行与物理反馈、长期部署——并在该生命周期内系统回顾代表性攻击、防御与评估方法。我们的分析显示，攻击入口、后果实现与防御干预常发生在具身闭环的不同阶段；还揭示端到端防护、真实世界评估与长期隐私治理方面的实质性缺口。本综述为理解当前进展并确定保障大模型驱动具身智能体安全的关键方向提供了统一视角。
summary_cn: 综述按五阶段生命周期（供应链、多模态输入、推理规划、动作执行、长期部署）系统梳理大模型具身智能体的攻击、防御与评估，指出攻击入口与防御干预常错位于不同阶段，并归纳端到端防护与长期隐私治理缺口。
objective_summary: 对大模型驱动具身智能体的安全与隐私研究做生命周期式系统梳理，覆盖五个阶段的代表性攻击、防御与评估方法，并归纳风险跨阶段传播与防护缺口。
evidence_note: 以五阶段生命周期组织现有研究并逐阶段梳理攻防与评估方法；摘要未给出纳入文献数量与检索方法学，系统化程度中等。
novelty_note: 已有针对 LLM 安全或机器人安全的综述，本文新意在以具身闭环生命周期统一组织并强调风险跨阶段错位。
scope: 结论适用于大模型驱动的具身智能体（感知-规划-执行闭环）；对纯软件智能体与传统工业机器人安全未覆盖。
limitations: 未报告文献筛选方法与纳入规模，覆盖完整性难以评估；缺乏对各攻击成功率与防御效果的定量比较；长期部署阶段的实证研究本身稀缺。

title: A Non-Invasive Cloud-Based Migration Strategy for Post-Quantum Cybersecurity in Smart HVAC Systems: Architecture, Implementation, and Empirical Evaluation
abstract: Legacy smart HVAC controllers rely on vendor-cloud TLS secured by ECDH and RSA, both broken by Shor's algorithm, and typical 10-15 year lifespans mean today's devices remain in service through the quantum-threat era. Direct on-device post-quantum cryptography is infeasible: an ESP32-S3, representative of capable HVAC hardware, has only 339 KB free heap against the 900 KB ML-KEM-768 requires, and even classical ECDH-P256 keygen (111.93 ms) dwarfs hardware AES-128 (0.032 ms). We propose a non-invasive PQC proxy, requiring no device, firmware, or vendor-cloud changes, performing ML-KEM-768 encapsulation and ML-DSA-65 authentication (NIST FIPS 203/204) with AES-256-GCM session keys via HKDF, implemented with Open Quantum Safe liboqs on a Raspberry Pi 4B gateway. Over 500 runs, the post-quantum handshake (Steps 1-6) completes in 2.48 ms, 0.38 ms slower than classical baseline, with PQC computation around 8% of handshake time at 20 ms simulated round-trip network latency. The gateway sustains 443 sessions/second, 100% success under 32 concurrent connections, extrapolating to 3546 sessions/second on a 32-core cloud instance. Five side-channel tests, including verified in-place session-key zeroization and a fixed-vs-random TVLA timing analysis, found no exploitable timing leakage or susceptibility to man-in-the-middle attacks. The architecture is vendor-agnostic and becomes unnecessary once vendors adopt NIST PQC natively.
comment: 27 pages, 12 figures (3 architecture diagrams, 9 experimental plots), 6 tables. Preprint; work in progress. Presents a non-invasive post-quantum cryptography proxy for smart HVAC systems with empirical evaluation on Raspberry Pi 4B and ESP32-S3 hardware (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65, liboqs)
title_cn: 面向智能 HVAC 系统后量子安全的非侵入式云侧迁移策略：架构、实现与实证评估
abstract_cn: 遗留智能 HVAC 控制器依赖厂商云的 TLS，采用会被 Shor 算法攻破的 ECDH 与 RSA，而典型 10–15 年的寿命意味着今天的设备将服役到量子威胁时代。直接在设备上部署后量子密码不可行：作为有代表性的 HVAC 硬件，ESP32-S3 仅 339 KB 空闲堆内存，而 ML-KEM-768 需要 900 KB；甚至经典 ECDH-P256 密钥生成（111.93 毫秒）也远慢于硬件 AES-128（0.032 毫秒）。我们提出非侵入式 PQC 代理：无需改动设备、固件或厂商云，在 Raspberry Pi 4B 网关上以 Open Quantum Safe liboqs 实现 ML-KEM-768 封装与 ML-DSA-65 认证（NIST FIPS 203/204）及经 HKDF 的 AES-256-GCM 会话密钥。在 500 余次运行中，后量子握手（步骤 1–6）2.48 毫秒完成，仅比经典基线慢 0.38 毫秒，在 20 毫秒模拟往返延迟下 PQC 计算约占握手时间的 8%。网关每秒支撑 443 个会话，32 路并发下成功率 100%，外推到 32 核云实例为每秒 3,546 个会话。五项侧信道测试（包括经验证的就地会话密钥清零与固定-随机的 TVLA 时序分析）未发现可利用的时序泄露或中间人攻击易感性。该架构与厂商无关，一旦厂商原生采用 NIST PQC 即可退役。
summary_cn: 为无法原生升级的智能 HVAC 提出非侵入式 PQC 代理（树莓派网关运行 ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65）：握手 2.48 毫秒仅慢 0.38 毫秒、443 会话/秒、32 并发 100% 成功，TVLA 等五项侧信道测试未发现可利用泄露。
objective_summary: 针对资源不足无法片上部署后量子密码的遗留 HVAC 设备，设计部署在网关的非侵入式 PQC 代理，在树莓派 4B 与 ESP32-S3 上测量握手延迟、吞吐、并发与侧信道表现。
evidence_note: Raspberry Pi 4B+ESP32-S3 真实硬件上 500+ 次运行、并发压测与五项侧信道测试（含 TVLA），自陈为进行中的预印本；无与同类 PQC 代理方案的对比。
novelty_note: 使用标准 NIST PQC 算法与 liboqs，贡献在于面向遗留 IoT 的非侵入式代理架构与实证数据，算法与组件均成熟。
scope: 结论适用于以 TLS 连接厂商云、算力受限的遗留 IoT 控制器；对设备直连与无网关架构、物理接触攻击未覆盖。
limitations: 网关成为新的单点故障与攻击目标；测量基于模拟网络延迟与实验室条件；物理攻击与实现级侧信道未全面评估。

title: MixGuard: Towards Detecting and Understanding Mixer Laundering on Ethereum
abstract: Mixers protect privacy by concealing deposit--withdrawal links, but are also abused to launder illicit funds. Existing anti-money laundering studies do not specifically target mixer laundering, while mixer research focuses on deanonymization rather than identifying laundering-related transactions. Public reports remain fragmented, leaving no public case-level dataset for systematic measurement and detection. To fill this void, this paper presents the first comprehensive study of mixer laundering on Ethereum. We first construct \textsc{MixLaunder}, the first public case-level dataset of mixer laundering. It covers 27 cases involving Tornado Cash and Railgun from 2020 to 2025 and labels 9,300 laundering-related transactions with case identities and observable upstream and downstream fund flows, including deposits totaling approximately \$1.1 billion. By comparing these transactions with background mixer usage, we identify five common strategies, showing that laundering evidence spans complementary behavioral and fund-flow contexts, while same-case activity is locally tight but weakly connected across bursts. Our analysis further reveals coverage gaps in mixer-side risk screening and representative deanonymization heuristics. Guided by these findings, we develop \textsc{MixGuard}, which combines tri-view representation learning with two-stage grouping for transaction-level detection and case-aware grouping. Under strict case-level holdout evaluation, \textsc{MixGuard} outperforms representative baselines, achieving 97.89\% detection precision and 98.73\% group purity, while its top ten groups cover 95.09\% of each case's transactions on average.
comment: accepted by ACM SIGMETRICS 2027
title_cn: MixGuard：以太坊混币器洗钱的检测与理解
abstract_cn: 混币器通过隐藏存取款关联保护隐私，但也常被滥用来洗白非法资金。现有反洗钱研究并不专门针对混币器洗钱，而混币器研究侧重去匿名化而非识别洗钱相关交易。公开报告零散，缺乏系统测量与检测所需的公开案例级数据集。为填补空白，本文对以太坊上的混币器洗钱进行首个全面研究。我们首先构建 MixLaunder——首个公开的混币器洗钱案例级数据集，覆盖 2020 至 2025 年涉及 Tornado Cash 与 Railgun 的 27 个案例，标注 9,300 笔带案例身份及可观测上下游资金流的洗钱相关交易，涉及存入总额约 11 亿美元。通过把这些交易与背景混币器使用对比，我们识别出五种常见策略，表明洗钱证据跨越互补的行为与资金流语境，而同案例活动局部紧密但在爆发之间弱连接。我们的分析还揭示混币器侧风险筛查与代表性去匿名化启发式的覆盖缺口。基于这些发现，我们开发 MixGuard：结合三视图表征学习与两阶段分组，实现交易级检测与案例感知分组。在严格的案例级留出评估下，MixGuard 优于代表性基线，取得 97.89% 的检测精确率与 98.73% 的分组纯度，其前十个组的平均覆盖率达各案例交易的 95.09%。
summary_cn: 构建首个公开案例级混币洗钱数据集 MixLaunder（27 案例、9,300 笔交易、约 11 亿美元），提出 MixGuard：案例级留出评估精确率 97.89%、分组纯度 98.73%。SIGMETRICS 2027 录用。
objective_summary: 构建首个公开的以太坊混币器洗钱案例级数据集 MixLaunder，通过案例分析归纳五种洗钱策略并指出筛查与去匿名化启发式的缺口，进而提出三视图表征学习+两阶段分组的检测与分组系统 MixGuard。
evidence_note: 基于公开报告构建 27 案例 9,300 笔标注交易的公开数据集，采用严格案例级留出评估并与代表性基线对比，SIGMETRICS 2027 录用。
novelty_note: 首个针对混币器洗钱的案例级公开数据集与系统测量，检测目标（洗钱识别而非去匿名化）与分组输出均为该方向首个。
scope: 结论适用于以太坊上 Tornado Cash/Railgun 类混币器的洗钱识别；对其他链、新混币协议与对抗性适应（刻意模仿背景使用）未验证。
limitations: 数据集来源为公开调查报告，可能漏掉未破案案例；标注依赖案例分析者的判断；模型对新型洗钱策略的泛化未评估。

title: The hidden life of signals: Time-domain inferences and other privacy attacks on everyday devices
abstract: In privacy research on radiofrequency-based protocols, the dominant focus has remained on Bluetooth, WiFi, and Zigbee, while a broader and arguably more consequential attack surface has gone largely unnoticed: the privacy risks created by the composition of everyday wireless protocols. Widely deployed systems such as KeeLoq remotes, vehicle TPMS sensors, and other sub-GHz devices continuously emit metadata and timing structure that, when analyzed jointly rather than in isolation, enable powerful behavioral inference. This work-in-progress paper argues that privacy leakage in these environments is not merely a property of individual protocols, but an emergent property of their interaction, correlation, and composition across devices, spaces, and routines. The resulting attack surface arises both from protocol metadata that directly degrades privacy and from the latent relationships between devices and the ways users move among and interact with them over time. We present preliminary evidence that these composed signals expose underappreciated opportunities for inference and tracking, and we outline a research agenda for characterizing and mitigating this broader class of privacy failures.
comment: Work in progress. Presented at the 2026 Symposium on the Science of Security (HotSoS 2026), Session 11, April 16, 2026. Session listing: this https URL 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Device identifiers are pseudonymized
title_cn: 信号的隐秘生活：日常设备的时域推断与其他隐私攻击
abstract_cn: 在基于射频协议的隐私研究中，主导焦点始终是蓝牙、WiFi 与 Zigbee，而一个更广泛、可以说更重要的攻击面却基本未被注意：日常无线协议组合产生的隐私风险。KeeLoq 遥控、车辆 TPMS 传感器等广泛部署的亚 GHz 系统持续发出元数据与时序结构，当联合而非孤立地分析时，可实现强大的行为推断。这项进行中的工作主张：这些环境中的隐私泄露不仅是单个协议的属性，而是其在设备、空间与日常活动之间交互、关联与组合的涌现属性。由此产生的攻击面既来自直接损害隐私的协议元数据，也来自设备之间及用户在设备间移动与互动方式的潜在关系。我们给出初步证据，表明这些组合信号暴露了被低估的推断与追踪机会，并概述一个刻画与缓解这类更广泛隐私失败的研究议程。
summary_cn: WIP 论文主张：KeeLoq、TPMS 等亚 GHz 协议与主流无线协议的组合分析构成涌现型隐私攻击面，时序与元数据的联合分析可实现行为推断与追踪；给出初步证据并提出研究议程。
objective_summary: 论证日常无线协议的组合而非单协议视角下的隐私泄露，给出亚 GHz 设备时域元数据联合分析的初步推断与追踪证据，并提出刻画与缓解组合隐私失败的研究议程。
evidence_note: HotSoS 2026 WIP，给出初步实验证据（设备标识符匿名化），但样本与协议覆盖有限，主张尚未系统验证。
novelty_note: 把隐私泄露重新框定为多协议组合的涌现属性并聚焦被忽视的亚 GHz 生态，属有启发性的问题重构。
scope: 结论适用于存在多协议并存、持续发射元数据的居住/通行环境；对加密元数据协议与高频采样受限设备未覆盖。
limitations: 证据为初步性质，未量化真实场景下的推断精度上限；设备种类覆盖有限；缓解议程尚停留在提案层面。

title: Trouble at the top: can Python extend the chains of trust in infrastructure firmware?
abstract: Compiled Python bytecode (PYC) has become an essential part of network switches, routers, and other network infrastructure devices. Our analysis shows that its integrity is implicitly trusted in multiple designs that make use of Python code at the top of the operational software, such as the management and control pane of enterprise network switches. At the same time, the integrity of PYC files is not covered under the traditional chain-of-trust models, due to complex interactions with the CPython loader, byte compiler, and other Python runtime components. We explore the risks inherent in including PYC and Python runtimes in the de facto trusted code basis of commercial enterprise equipment and offer a comprehensive framework for understanding emergent behaviors in these designs.
comment: Work in progress. Presented at the 2026 Symposium on the Science of Security (HotSoS 2026), Session 2, April 14, 2026. Session listing: this https URL 9 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
title_cn: 隐忧在上层：Python 能否扩展基础设施固件的信任链？
abstract_cn: 编译后的 Python 字节码（PYC）已成为网络交换机、路由器等网络基础设施设备的重要组成部分。我们的分析表明，在运营软件顶层使用 Python 代码的设计（如企业网络交换机的管理与控制平面）中，PYC 的完整性被隐式信任。与此同时，PYC 文件的完整性并未被传统信任链模型覆盖，原因在于其与 CPython 加载器、字节编译器及其他 Python 运行时组件的复杂交互。我们探讨把 PYC 与 Python 运行时纳入商用企业设备事实可信代码基所固有的风险，并提供一个理解这些设计中涌现行为的综合框架。
summary_cn: WIP 研究：企业网络设备管理与控制平面的 PYC 字节码完整性被隐式信任，却不在传统信任链模型覆盖范围内；分析其与 CPython 加载器/字节编译器的复杂交互带来的风险并给出分析框架。
objective_summary: 分析网络基础设施设备中编译 Python 字节码（PYC）被隐式纳入可信代码基的现状，梳理其与 CPython 运行时组件交互导致的信任链覆盖缺口，并提出理解涌现行为的框架。
evidence_note: 对真实设备设计做了定性分析并指出信任链缺口，HotSoS 2026 WIP 论文，无实验验证或漏洞实证。
novelty_note: PYC/Python 运行时完整性未被信任链模型覆盖这一问题此前少被系统讨论，属新视角的问题界定与框架构建。
scope: 结论适用于管理与控制平面运行 Python 代码的企业网络设备；对仅用 Python 做一次性脚本的设备与消费级设备未覆盖。
limitations: 工作尚处早期（WIP），未给出可利用漏洞的实证；框架的完备性未经多厂商设备验证；缓解方案未展开。

title: Agent Name Collision Attacks in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: Multi-agent hosts turn remote Agent Cards into local agents, tools, workflow targets, and broker routes. A2A defines the card's name as human-readable metadata, not as a stable identity, and specifies no collision semantics. The security failure begins when a host nevertheless uses that remote name as a local routing identifier. We traced registration through dispatch and ran isolated regression tests at seven pinned open-source revisions. Six client-style integrations selected an attacker-controlled peer's client or loopback endpoint for a request addressed to a trusted peer's name. A seventh, brokered implementation collapsed both peers onto one name-derived route; queue and access-control state determine whether the result is interception or denial. The common result is wrong-peer dispatch, not universal privilege inheritance. Synthetic credential and tool tests found no A-specific credential transfer in the tested client bindings and no direct transfer of A-owned tools. The broker path forwards a caller-configuration object; delegated identity or tokens reach B only if present and B can consume the route. Two other paths expose a later, model-mediated decision rather than direct execution authority. The necessary conditions assign different responsibilities to the protocol, implementations, and deployments. Hosts should route by an origin-bound stable identity, keep names presentational, and reject ambiguous aliases. The evidence establishes a recurring implementation vulnerability class, not a universal A2A protocol exploit or a count of vulnerable deployments.
title_cn: 多智能体系统中的智能体名称冲突攻击
abstract_cn: 多智能体宿主把远程 Agent Card 转换为本地智能体、工具、工作流目标与代理路由。A2A 把卡片的名称定义为人类可读的元数据而非稳定身份，且未规定冲突语义。当宿主仍然把该远程名称用作本地路由标识符时，安全问题开始出现。我们从注册追踪到分发，并在七个钉住版本的开源实现上运行隔离回归测试。六个客户端式集成会把发往可信对端名称的请求选中攻击者控制的客户端或回环端点；第七个代理式实现把两个对端折叠到同一名字派生路由上，队列与访问控制状态决定结果是拦截还是拒绝。共同结果是对端错误分发，而非普遍的权限继承。合成凭证与工具测试在受测客户端绑定中未发现 A 专属凭证转移，也未发现 A 所拥有工具的直接转移；代理路径转发调用者配置对象，仅当委托身份或 token 存在且 B 能消费该路由时才会到达 B；另两条路径暴露的是后续由模型中介的决策而非直接执行权限。必要条件为协议、实现与部署分别划定了责任。宿主应基于来源绑定的稳定身份路由、把名称保持为展示用途并拒绝歧义别名。证据确立的是一个反复出现的实现漏洞类，而非普遍的 A2A 协议漏洞或易受影响部署的计数。
summary_cn: 发现智能体名称冲突漏洞类：七个钉住版本开源 A2A 宿主中六个把发往可信对端的请求路由到攻击者控制端点，造成对端错误分发；未见凭证/工具普遍转移，建议路由改用来源绑定稳定身份。
objective_summary: 系统检验多智能体宿主以 A2A 卡片名称作路由标识的后果：在七个开源实现的钉住版本上运行隔离回归测试，刻画对端错误分发的发生条件、影响边界与协议/实现/部署的责任划分。
evidence_note: 七个开源实现的钉住版本+隔离回归测试，方法可复现；但样本限于七个实现，未统计在野部署面，无使用真实凭证的实验。
novelty_note: 首次系统命名并检验「名称冲突导致对端错误分发」这一多智能体实现漏洞类，明确其与协议漏洞、权限继承的边界。
scope: 结论适用于使用 A2A 类远程智能体卡片并把人类可读名称用作路由键的宿主实现；对私有协议与完全去中心化的发现机制未覆盖。
limitations: 仅测试七个实现且为钉住版本，最新版本可能已修复；合成测试未覆盖全部凭证类型；代理路径的影响依赖部署态队列与访问控制配置。

title: CCR: Towards a Common, Quality-Gated CACAO Integrations Registry for European Cybersecurity Automation
abstract: Standardised, machine-readable cybersecurity playbooks provide a basis for portable, shareable, and reusable incident-response logic. OASIS CACAO provides a vendor-neutral representation for such playbooks, but not the product-specific integration artefacts needed to invoke external products and services. We introduce the Common CACAO Registry (CCR), an open, provenance-aware registry of CACAO HTTP-API connector envelopes. Each envelope captures an API operation's command, inputs, target, authentication-related information, provenance, validation evidence, and maturity metadata. CCR is quality-gated, with acceptance requiring both CACAO v2 schema validity and a mean back-validation score of at least 0.8 against the source OpenAPI operation, while a six-level maturity model records progressively stronger evidence and distinguishes gate acceptance from operational readiness. To seed CCR, we develop a hybrid OpenAPI-to-CACAO pipeline. Deterministic code extracts source-derived interface facts, generates identifiers, wires cross-references, and validates structure, while a constrained LLM provides bounded semantic enrichment, including action naming, authentication interpretation, and CACAO activity annotation. Evaluation across eight security APIs yields 713 CACAO-schema-valid envelopes with a mean back-validation score of 91.5%, of which 675 produce well-formed, dispatchable HTTP requests in a local harness. Comparison with a deterministic rule-based baseline shows that mechanical API structure is preserved more reliably through rule-based translation, while the LLM contributes bounded semantic enrichment, most notably CACAO activity annotation. Together, these results support CCR as reusable integration infrastructure for CACAO action steps and as an initial foundation for a broader common European registry.
comment: 20 pages. Accepted at the 12th Workshop on the Security of Industrial Control Systems & of Cyber-Physical Systems (CyberICPS 2026), held in conjunction with ESORICS 2026. To appear in Springer LNCS
title_cn: CCR：面向欧洲网络安全自动化的通用质量门控 CACAO 集成注册表
abstract_cn: 标准化、机器可读的网络安全剧本为便携、可共享、可复用的事件响应逻辑提供基础。OASIS CACAO 为此类剧本提供了厂商中立的表示，但未提供调用外部产品与服务所需的产品专属集成工件。我们引入通用 CACAO 注册表（CCR）：一个开放、带溯源的 CACAO HTTP-API 连接器信封注册表。每个信封捕捉 API 操作的命令、输入、目标、认证相关信息、溯源、验证证据与成熟度元数据。CCR 是质量门控的：接受要求同时满足 CACAO v2 模式有效性与对源 OpenAPI 操作均值不低于 0.8 的回验分数，并以六级成熟度模型记录逐级增强的证据、区分门接受与运行就绪。为充实 CCR，我们开发了混合 OpenAPI-to-CACAO 流水线：确定性代码抽取源生接口事实、生成标识符、连接交叉引用并验证结构，受约束的 LLM 提供有边界的语义增强（动作命名、认证解释与 CACAO 活动标注）。在八个安全 API 上的评估产出 713 个 CACAO 模式有效的信封、平均回验分数 91.5%，其中 675 个在本地 harness 中产生格式良好、可分发的 HTTP 请求。与确定性规则基线的比较显示：机械性 API 结构经规则翻译保留得更可靠，而 LLM 贡献有边界的语义增强，最突出的是 CACAO 活动标注。这些结果支持 CCR 作为 CACAO 动作步骤的可复用集成基础设施与更广泛的欧洲通用注册表的初步基础。
summary_cn: 提出质量门控的 CACAO 连接器注册表 CCR 与混合 OpenAPI 转换流水线：八个安全 API 产出 713 个模式有效信封、平均回验 91.5%、675 个可分发请求；规则翻译保结构更可靠，LLM 贡献有边界的语义增强。
objective_summary: 设计带溯源与六级成熟度的质量门控 CACAO HTTP-API 连接器注册表 CCR，配套确定性代码+受约束 LLM 的 OpenAPI 转换流水线，在八个安全 API 上评估信封有效性、回验分数与可分发率。
evidence_note: 八个安全 API 上量化 713 个信封的模式有效率、91.5% 回验分数与 675 个可分发请求，并与规则基线消融比较；无在野部署与统计检验。
novelty_note: CACAO 剧本标准已有，新意在首个质量门控连接器注册表设计、确定性+LLM 混合转换管线及成熟度模型。
scope: 结论适用于 HTTP-API 型安全产品集成与 CACAO v2 生态；对非 HTTP 接口、专有协议与跨组织信任治理未覆盖。
limitations: 评估限于八个 API，泛化性未知；LLM 语义增强的错误对门控的穿透情况未细分；注册表的运维与治理模式未落地实现。

title: Control-Token Injection Suppresses Chain-of-Thought and Defeats Reasoning-Based Oversight in Tool-Using Agents
abstract: The safety of a tool-using language model agent is usually treated as a property of the model alone. We give controlled, full-precision evidence that it is instead a joint property of the model and the software that renders its chat template and parses its tool calls, the decoding harness, and that both halves are attackable from untrusted input. On the released gpt-oss-20b reasoning model under its published tool sandbox, appending a single string of the model's own channel-control tokens to a user message makes the tokenizer render a reasoning turn that is already complete, so the model writes no chain-of-thought and proceeds directly to the tool call. Across forty tasks the model already completes, the reasoning channel falls from a mean of 52.5 tokens to zero on every trial while the http.post still fires on every trial. A rule monitor and a cross-family language-model monitor detect the unsafe request on all plain trials and no forged trials, and on overtly malicious requests the attack converts 39.6% of the model's refusals into completed exfiltrations. Separately, whether an identical tool-call generation fires is decided by the harness parser, not the model: a truncation-tolerant regular expression fires a call whose closing token is missing while a strict one drops it, and two parsers shipped for the Gemma agent give opposite outcomes on identical greedy generations, firing on all twenty-four trials and on none. We show the suppression can be delivered indirectly and characterize its dependence on the chat template across two more reasoning models, and we evaluate input sanitization, parser hardening, and empty-reasoning detection as defenses; flagging an absent trace catches the basic attack but not an adaptive benign decoy. All measurements use greedy decoding on publicly released models. Code and per-trial logs: https://github.com/Usama1002/deleting-the-trace
title_cn: 控制词元注入可抑制思维链并击破工具型智能体的基于推理的监督
abstract_cn: 工具型语言模型智能体的安全通常被视为模型自身的属性。我们以受控的全精度证据表明：它实际上是模型与渲染其聊天模板、解析其工具调用的软件及解码框架的联合属性，且两半都可被不可信输入攻击。在已发布的 gpt-oss-20b 推理模型及其公开工具沙箱下，向用户消息追加一串模型自身的通道控制词元，会使分词器渲染出一个「已经完成」的推理轮：模型不再写任何思维链而直接发起工具调用。在模型本已能完成的四十个任务上，推理通道的平均长度从 52.5 个词元降为每次试验均为零，而 http.post 在每次试验都照常触发。规则监视器与跨家族语言模型监视器在全部常规试验中检出不安全请求、在全部伪造试验中均未检出；面对显式恶意请求，该攻击把模型 39.6% 的拒绝转化为完成的数据外传。另外，同一工具调用生成是否触发由框架解析器而非模型决定：一个容忍截断的正则表达式会对缺少闭合词元的调用触发执行，而严格的解析器则丢弃之；为 Gemma 智能体提供的两个解析器在完全相同的贪心生成上给出相反结果——一个在全部 24 次试验触发、一个零触发。我们证明该抑制可经间接输入投递，并在另外两个推理模型上刻画其对聊天模板的依赖；我们评估输入清洗、解析器加固与空推理检测作为防御——标记缺失轨迹可捕获基本攻击但防不住自适应良性诱饵。所有测量均在公开模型上以贪心解码完成。代码与逐试验日志：https://github.com/Usama1002/deleting-the-trace
summary_cn: 发现控制词元注入使 gpt-oss-20b 推理通道从均值 52.5 词元降为零而工具调用照常触发，39.6% 的拒绝被转化为外传；监视器全部失效，解析器差异可独立决定调用是否触发；代码与逐试验日志公开。
objective_summary: 以全精度受控实验证明聊天模板渲染与工具调用解析是与模型同等重要的攻击面：通道控制词元注入可清空思维链并保留工具执行，解析器实现差异可独立决定同一生成的触发，并评估三类防御。
evidence_note: 全精度受控实验、40 任务逐试验日志公开、跨三个推理模型与两个解析器的对照、防御评估齐备，测量以贪心解码全部可复现。
novelty_note: 首次以「删除推理轨迹」为目标的词元级攻击，并把安全定位为模型+渲染/解析软件的联合属性，揭示基于推理的监督的结构性盲区与解析器责任分离。
scope: 结论适用于把推理轨迹作为监督信号、依赖聊天模板渲染与外部解析器的工具型智能体；对无显式推理通道或模板完全自定义的闭源 API 适用性未验证。
limitations: 主实验集中于 gpt-oss-20b 单模型；空推理检测防不住自适应良性诱饵；对在环强化训练或输出过滤防御未评估。

title: MDRC: A Deployable State-Recovery Defense for Traffic Signal Control under Sensor Corruption
abstract: Traffic Signal Control (TSC) is a safety-critical cyber-physical system that relies on real-time sensing. Corrupted observations caused by adversarial perturbations or sensor failures can propagate from the sensing layer into the controller and degrade traffic efficiency. Existing robust Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based TSC methods often suffer from limited cross-city generalization, high inference latency, and weak recovery under partial observability. We present MDRC (Meta-Diffusion-based framework for Resilient traffic signal Control against adversarial attacks and sensor failures), a post-detection state-recovery defense inserted between sensing and control. MDRC reconstructs trustworthy traffic states before they are consumed by the controller. It combines Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM) for efficient state recovery with Reptile meta-learning for a transferable initialization across cities. We provide an optimization-based view of the DDIM recovery dynamics and establish a recovery-error bound that separates score approximation, numerical discretization, and initialization mismatch. Across seven real-world-derived CityFlow benchmarks, MDRC reduces Average Travel Time by 6.77% under stochastic and policy-aware attacks and by 12.75% under structured sensor loss, while improving state-recovery fidelity. We further evaluate 3,600 seconds of real roadside measurements with 50% of detector channels disabled and integrate MDRC into a hardware-in-the-loop traffic-signal stack. Over a 9.16-hour run with 32,389 sensing/control cycles, the system achieves 99.79% decision availability, produces no out-of-plan recommendations, and requires approximately 38 ms of component-wise processing per one-second control interval.
title_cn: MDRC：传感器受损下交通信号控制的可部署状态恢复防御
abstract_cn: 交通信号控制（TSC）是依赖实时感知的安全关键信息物理系统。由对抗扰动或传感器故障造成的受损观测会从感知层传播进控制器并降低交通效率。现有鲁棒的基于强化学习（RL）的 TSC 方法常受跨城市泛化有限、推理延迟高与部分可观测下恢复能力弱之困。我们提出 MDRC（基于元扩散的对抗攻击与传感器故障韧性交通信号控制框架），一个插入感知与控制之间的检测后状态恢复防御：MDRC 在可信状态被控制器消费前重建之。它结合去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）实现高效状态恢复，并以 Reptile 元学习获得跨城市可迁移初始化。我们给出 DDIM 恢复动力学的优化视角，并建立分离分数近似、数值离散化与初始化失配的恢复误差界。在七个真实世界衍生的 CityFlow 基准上，MDRC 在随机与策略感知攻击下将平均旅行时间降低 6.77%，在结构化传感器损失下降低 12.75%，同时提升状态恢复保真度。我们进一步用 50% 检测通道被禁用的 3,600 秒真实路侧测量评估，并将 MDRC 集成到硬件在环交通信号栈：在 9.16 小时、32,389 个感知/控制周期的运行中，系统达到 99.79% 的决策可用率、无计划外建议，每个一秒控制区间的分量式处理约 38 毫秒。
summary_cn: 提出检测后状态恢复防御 MDRC（DDIM+Reptile 跨城初始化）并给出恢复误差界：攻击下平均旅行时间降 6.77%、结构化传感损失降 12.75%；硬件在环 9.16 小时决策可用率 99.79%、单步约 38 毫秒。
objective_summary: 面向感知受损的 RL 交通信号控制，提出插入感知与控制之间的元扩散状态恢复防御 MDRC，建立恢复误差界，并在仿真基准、真实路侧数据与硬件在环栈三个层面评估恢复质量、延迟与可用率。
evidence_note: 七个基准+3,600 秒真实路侧测量+9.16 小时硬件在环（32,389 周期）的三层评估，量化攻击/故障下的旅行时间、可用率与延迟，并附恢复误差界。
novelty_note: 扩散模型恢复与元学习均为成熟组件，新意在于面向 TSC 的检测后恢复定位、跨城可迁移初始化与分离三类误差源的恢复误差界。
scope: 结论适用于 CityFlow 类信号控制场景与被测路侧部署；对多路口强耦合路网、更复杂攻击者模型与大规模城市部署未验证。
limitations: 恢复以单控制器状态为对象，跨路口协同攻击下的传播未分析；路侧测量限于 3,600 秒；扩散采样的延迟在更低算力设备上未测。

title: Issuer-Sovereign Agentic Payments
abstract: AI agents are beginning to make real payments. Current approaches let an agent pay by relying on a credential provider that, in the approaches deployed today, typically sits outside the cardholder's bank. The spending rules are then enforced by the card network or that provider, and not by the bank itself. This leaves the issuing bank, which carries the financial risk, with little direct control at the moment a payment happens. This paper describes Issuer-Sovereign Agentic Payments, a method that keeps that control with the issuer. The cardholder approves a spending rule once, and the bank's own authentication component records it. Later, when the agent pays a specific merchant, the bank checks the merchant against the approved rule and generates the card authentication value only if the merchant is allowed. The payment then travels the normal card rails and is validated by the issuer, with no extra dependency introduced at execution.
title_cn: 发卡行主权的智能体支付
abstract_cn: AI 智能体开始进行真实支付。当前做法让智能体依赖一个凭证提供方完成支付，而按今天已部署的方案，该提供方通常位于持卡人银行之外。消费规则随即由卡组织或该提供方执行，而非银行本身。这使得承担金融风险的发卡银行在支付发生时刻几乎没有直接控制权。本文描述发卡行主权的智能体支付：一种把控制权保留在发卡行的方法。持卡人一次性批准消费规则，由银行自身的认证组件记录；此后当智能体向特定商户付款时，银行核对该商户是否在批准规则之内，仅当允许时才生成卡片认证值。支付随后走正常卡组织通道并由发卡行验证，执行时不引入任何额外依赖。
summary_cn: 提出把智能体支付控制权收回发卡行的方案：持卡人一次性批准消费规则，银行认证组件按「商户是否在批准清单内」决定是否生成卡片认证值，支付走正常卡通道，执行时无额外依赖。
objective_summary: 分析现有智能体支付中发卡行缺乏支付时刻控制权的问题，提出由银行认证组件记录持卡人批准规则、按商户匹配生成卡片认证值的发卡行主权方案并描述其执行流程。
evidence_note: 纯方案描述与流程设计，无实验、原型测量或部署评估，也未讨论对抗场景下的安全分析。
novelty_note: 机制复用既有卡片认证与商户核验组件，新意在于把智能体消费规则的执行点收归发卡行的治理设计，属新问题空间中的增量方案。
scope: 结论适用于基于卡组织通道的智能体支付；对账户扣账、实时支付网络与跨行智能体代理场景未覆盖。
limitations: 未评估商户匹配的误判对用户与商户的影响；规则表达力（金额、频次、类别）未形式化；无原型或与既有智能体支付方案的对比。

title: A Bulletproof Business? Towards Detecting Infrastructure-as-a-Service Offerings on Telegram
abstract: Cybercriminal operations increasingly depend on reusable digital infrastructure---including hosting, proxies, and virtual private networks (VPNs)---rented through Cybercrime-as-a-Service markets and advertised on platforms such as Telegram. We present a taxonomy for identifying Telegram messages advertising cybercriminal Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS). The taxonomy comprises six service categories across compute, network, and communication infrastructure, together with three trust attributes: Bulletproof, Payment Security, and Transparency. Using 261 human-annotated messages, we evaluate keyword-based and TF--IDF classifiers and examine prompt-based large language models as exploratory baselines. We select a TF--IDF pipeline and apply it to 1,116,071 messages from 167 cybercrime-related Telegram communities. The pipeline assigns at least one infrastructure category to 207,244 messages (18.57%) spanning 113 communities. Classified advertising is highly concentrated: a single community accounts for 50.3% of infrastructure-positive messages, while the trust-attribute classifiers identify Bulletproof claims in 37.66% of those messages. These findings characterize the scale, composition, and concentration of infrastructure advertising on Telegram and can inform the prioritization of communities and actors for monitoring and investigation.
comment: To appear in the proceedings of the 2026 ACM CCS TAKEDOWN Workshop (Technical Analysis and Knowledge Exchange on Disrupting Online Criminal Networks)
title_cn: 防弹生意？面向 Telegram 基础设施即服务广告的检测
abstract_cn: 网络犯罪运营日益依赖可复用的数字基础设施——包括托管、代理与虚拟专用网（VPN）——通过「网络犯罪即服务」市场出租，并在 Telegram 等平台上做广告。我们提出一个用于识别 Telegram 上网络犯罪基础设施即服务（IaaS）广告消息的分类体系，涵盖计算、网络与通信基础设施的六个服务类别，以及防弹（Bulletproof）、支付安全与透明度三个信任属性。基于 261 条人工标注消息，我们评估基于关键词与 TF-IDF 的分类器，并考察基于提示的大语言模型作为探索性基线。我们选定 TF-IDF 流水线，应用于来自 167 个网络犯罪相关 Telegram 社群的 1,116,071 条消息。该流水线把至少一个基础设施类别分配给 207,244 条消息（18.57%），横跨 113 个社群。广告投放高度集中：单个社群占基础设施正类消息的 50.3%，信任属性分类器在其中 37.66% 的消息中识别出防弹声明。这些发现刻画了 Telegram 上基础设施广告的规模、构成与集中度，可用于为监测与调查确定社群与行为者的优先级。
summary_cn: 提出六类别+三信任属性的 Telegram 犯罪 IaaS 广告分类体系，TF-IDF 流水线应用于 167 个社群 111.6 万条消息：18.57% 含基础设施广告、单个社群占 50.3%、37.66% 带防弹声明。CCS TAKEDOWN 2026 工作坊录用。
objective_summary: 构建识别 Telegram 网络犯罪 IaaS 广告的分类体系与 TF-IDF 检测流水线，在 261 条人工标注消息上比较分类器，并对 167 个社群的 111.6 万条消息进行规模、构成与集中度测量。
evidence_note: 261 条人工标注用于方法评估，流水线应用于 167 个社群 1,116,071 条真实消息的在野大规模数据，CCS TAKEDOWN 2026 工作坊录用；分类器输出的大规模正确率未经抽样人工验证。
novelty_note: 网络犯罪市场测量已有工作，新意在首个聚焦 IaaS 广告的六类别+信任属性分类体系及对应的生态级测量。
scope: 结论适用于 Telegram 上网络犯罪社群的广告生态；对私域频道、其他平台与消息删除/迁移动态未覆盖。
limitations: TF-IDF 分类器的精确率/召回率限于 261 条标注评估，规模结果可能含分类误差；单社群集中度受采样窗口影响；LLM 基线仅作探索性对比。

title: Extracting CNNs in the Unknown-Architecture and Feedback-Agnostic Setting
abstract: This paper studies the cryptanalytic extraction of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Existing cryptanalytic extraction attacks on CNNs assume that the network architecture is known, and try to recover model parameters.In this paper, we prove for the first time that the architecture assumption can be removed for CNNs with both max and average pooling. Our core finding is that the spatial geometry of the weight vectors recovered by existing parameter-recovery attacks naturally leaks the architecture. We formalize this geometry and establish its correspondence with the architectural knowledge of a convolutional layer: (1) The sparsity consistency with the convolution receptive field reveals the layer type, the kernel size, and the stride; (2) The numerical consistency with the kernel parameters reveals the padding mode and the output-channel number; (3) The structural consistency with the pooling operation reveals the pooling type, the window size, and the stride. Although the recovered vectors are obtained using different methods in the raw-output and hard label settings, their spatial geometry remains the same. Therefore, our architecture recovery is feedback-agnostic: combined with a parameter-recovery attack, it yields a complete cryptanalytic extraction framework that recovers both the architecture and the parameters in the black-box setting. Extensive experiments, including both layer-wise and end-to-end ones, on a wide range of CNNs demonstrate that simultaneously recovering the network architecture and the model parameters is practical.
title_cn: 未知架构且与反馈无关设定下的 CNN 提取
abstract_cn: 本文研究卷积神经网络（CNN）的密码分析式提取。现有针对 CNN 的密码分析式提取攻击假设网络架构已知，并试图恢复模型参数。本文首次证明：对同时使用最大池化与平均池化的 CNN，该架构假设可以被移除。核心发现是：现有参数恢复攻击所恢复的权重向量的空间几何会自然泄露架构。我们对该几何进行形式化，并建立其与卷积层架构知识的对应关系：(1) 与卷积感受野的稀疏一致性揭示层类型、卷积核大小与步幅；(2) 与卷积核参数的数值一致性揭示填充模式与输出通道数；(3) 与池化操作的结构一致性揭示池化类型、窗口大小与步幅。尽管原始输出与硬标签设定下恢复向量所用的方法不同，其空间几何保持一致，因此我们的架构恢复与反馈无关：与参数恢复攻击结合，即构成在黑盒设定下同时恢复架构与参数的完整密码分析式提取框架。在广泛的 CNN 上进行的逐层与端到端大量实验表明，同时恢复网络架构与模型参数是实际可行的。
summary_cn: 首次证明 CNN 提取可去除架构假设：恢复权重的空间几何泄露层类型、卷积核/步幅、填充、通道数与池化配置，且与反馈类型无关；与参数恢复结合即得黑盒下架构+参数的完整提取框架。
objective_summary: 形式化参数恢复攻击所得权重向量的空间几何与 CNN 架构要素的对应关系，提出与反馈无关的架构恢复方法，并与参数恢复攻击组合成黑盒完整提取框架，在广泛 CNN 上逐层与端到端验证。
evidence_note: 在广泛 CNN 上做逐层与端到端两类实验验证架构恢复与完整提取，但摘要未报告具体模型数量、成功率分布与统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次移除模型提取中的架构已知假设，权重几何泄露架构的形式化与反馈无关性是该方向的实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于含最大/平均池化的 CNN 及原始输出或硬标签访问；对 Transformer、动态架构与含随机化的防御部署未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖已有参数恢复攻击的质量；对批归一化等未提及组件的处理未说明；输出扰动、水印等防御下的鲁棒性未评估。

title: EVAGE: Autonomous MEV Generation and Adaptation via Multi-Agent Harness
abstract: Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) has evolved into a major economic force in blockchain ecosystems, yet its capture is dominated by experienced teams, and both strategy design and implementation rely on manual expert work that scales poorly across heterogeneous protocols and chains. We present EVAGE, the first fully autonomous multi-agent framework for end-to-end MEV strategy generation and adaptation. Equipped with three specialized operation modes, it automatically discovers novel MEV variants, adapts execution logic across disparate protocols, and ports strategies between chains, including Layer-1 and Layer-2 networks. To avoid inference latency on the critical MEV execution path, EVAGE generates and refines MEV bot code offline rather than making real-time decisions directly. Under the coordination of an orchestrator agent, three specialized subagents collectively implement and repair the full MEV bot workflow via closed-loop diagnostics, eliminating human intervention while producing validated and deterministic Proof-of-Concept implementations. We evaluate EVAGE on over 1.5M blocks from each of Ethereum, Base, and BNB Smart Chain (BSC). On Ethereum, EVAGE uncovers five novel MEV strategy variants, yielding a profit increase of 1.02$\times$ to 15.97$\times$. It also successfully adapts 11 MEV strategies from CPMM to both CLMM and Balancer V2 and ports strategies from Ethereum to Base and BSC, all with less than 60 dollars in LLM token costs.
title_cn: EVAGE：基于多智能体框架的自主 MEV 生成与适配
abstract_cn: 最大可提取价值（MEV）已演化为区块链生态的主要经济力量，但其捕获由经验丰富的团队主导，策略设计与实现依赖人工专家工作，难以跨异构协议与链扩展。我们提出 EVAGE，首个面向端到端 MEV 策略生成与适配的全自主多智能体框架。它配备三种专用操作模式，可自动发现新 MEV 变体、跨不同协议适配执行逻辑、并在链间（包括 Layer-1 与 Layer-2 网络）移植策略。为避免推理延迟进入 MEV 执行关键路径，EVAGE 离线生成并改进 MEV 机器人代码，而非实时决策。在编排智能体协调下，三个专用子智能体通过闭环诊断共同实现并修复完整的 MEV 机器人工作流，无需人工干预即可产出经过验证的确定性概念验证实现。我们在以太坊、Base 与 BNB Smart Chain（BSC）各超过 150 万个区块上评估 EVAGE。在以太坊上，EVAGE 发现五个新 MEV 策略变体，利润提升 1.02 倍至 15.97 倍；它还成功把 11 个 MEV 策略从 CPMM 适配到 CLMM 与 Balancer V2，并把策略从以太坊移植到 Base 与 BSC，全程 LLM token 成本低于 60 美元。
summary_cn: EVAGE：首个端到端自主 MEV 策略生成与适配多智能体框架，在以太坊/Base/BSC 各 150 万区块上发现 5 个新策略变体（利润 1.02–15.97 倍），跨协议适配并跨链移植 11 个策略，成本低于 60 美元。
objective_summary: 构建由编排器与三个子智能体组成的多智能体框架 EVAGE，离线生成、修复并验证 MEV 机器人代码，实现新变体发现、跨协议适配与跨链移植，并在三条链各 150 万区块上评估收益与成本。
evidence_note: 在三条真实公链各 150 万区块的在野数据上验证，产出可运行的确定性 PoC 并量化利润倍数与 60 美元成本；为攻击性工具评估，无对照防御实验。
novelty_note: 首个全自主端到端 MEV 策略生成与适配框架，把 MEV 捕获从专家手工扩展为自动发现-适配-移植的闭环。
scope: 结论适用于以太坊虚拟机系公链与 CPMM/CLMM/Balancer V2 类 AMM 协议；对非 EVM 链、中心化做市与对抗性反制（如区块提议者反击）未评估。
limitations: 策略发现依赖链上历史模式，对全新结构的机会泛化未知；利润测量窗口有限；作为攻击性工具，其滥用面与防御对策未讨论。

title: RAMP: Reversing Adversarial Perturbations to Strengthen Clean-Label Backdoor Attacks against Malware Detectors
abstract: Deep learning-based malware detectors are commonly updated by fine-tuning on newly collected samples, but this practical update pipeline also creates an attack surface for training-time backdoor attacks. In realistic crowdsourced data collection, however, strict label vetting typically restricts attackers to the clean-label setting, in which poisoned samples must retain benign labels and functionality, making effective backdoor injection substantially harder. We present a new attack perspective based on feature-space manipulation: instead of relying solely on stronger trigger designs or selecting benign samples that are naturally similar to malware, we deliberately construct benign programs whose representations shift toward the malware region before trigger injection, thereby creating stronger feature-label conflicts during training. Based on this insight, we propose RAMP, an attack enhancement method that uses a genetic algorithm to optimize reversed adversarial perturbations under black-box access and then injects them through functionality-preserving binary manipulations. Extensive experiments show that RAMP substantially improves attack effectiveness over trigger-only baselines, with especially pronounced gains at low poisoning ratios, while maintaining accuracy on clean data. Moreover, RAMP can be combined with advanced trigger designs.
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Information Security and Cryptology (Inscrypt 2026). Code: this https URL
title_cn: RAMP：反转对抗扰动以强化针对恶意软件检测器的干净标签后门攻击
abstract_cn: 基于深度学习的恶意软件检测器通常通过在新采集样本上微调来更新，但这一现实更新流水线也为训练期后门攻击创造了攻击面。在现实的众包数据采集中，严格的标签审查通常把攻击者限制在干净标签设定：投毒样本必须保留良性标签与功能，使有效注入后门显著更难。我们提出一种基于特征空间操纵的新攻击视角：不再只依赖更强的触发器设计或挑选天然与恶意软件相似的良性样本，而是在触发器注入前有意构造其表示向恶意区域偏移的良性程序，从而在训练中制造更强的特征-标签冲突。基于这一洞察，我们提出 RAMP——一种攻击增强方法，在黑盒访问下用遗传算法优化反转的对抗扰动，再通过保持功能的二进制操纵将其注入。大量实验表明，RAMP 相比仅触发器基线显著提升攻击效果，在低投毒比例下增益尤其明显，同时保持干净数据上的准确率。此外，RAMP 可与先进触发器设计组合。
summary_cn: 提出 RAMP：黑盒下用遗传算法优化反转对抗扰动、经功能保持注入使良性样本表示向恶意区偏移，显著增强干净标签后门攻击，低投毒比例下增益最明显。Inscrypt 2026 录用，代码公开。
objective_summary: 面向恶意软件检测器微调更新流水线，提出以特征空间操纵强化干净标签后门攻击的方法 RAMP：遗传算法优化反转对抗扰动并做功能保持注入，实验对比仅触发器基线并验证与触发器设计的可组合性。
evidence_note: 大量实验覆盖不同投毒比例并报告干净准确率保持，Inscrypt 2026 录用且代码公开；但摘要未给出具体数据集规模与统计检验。
novelty_note: 干净标签后门与对抗扰动均为已有技术，新意在「预移位特征表示再注入触发器」的组合视角及其在功能保持约束下的实现。
scope: 结论适用于以微调方式更新、训练数据含众包样本的深度学习恶意软件检测器；对训练期全程受控或数据溯源严格的场景未评估。
limitations: 遗传算法优化带来计算成本；扰动依赖代理模型的可迁移性；对基于表示异常或投毒样本检测的防御未评估。

title: Only Pay What You Must Spend: On-Demand Privacy Budget Payment for Differentially Private RAG
abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) on sensitive data via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces severe privacy risks. Recent studies apply Differential Privacy (DP) to LLMs with RAG for formal privacy guarantees. However, existing DP-RAG frameworks rapidly exhaust the privacy budget. Although recent efforts attempt to save the budget by narrowing the retrieval scope or sparsifying private generation, these methods themselves cumulatively consume the budget, whereas they could actually rely merely on public information or at a negligible one-time privacy cost. This mismatch fails to align budget expenditure with the model's actual reliance on private data, causing substantial waste on operations that require no private access. To address this, we propose SparsePay-RAG, adopting "only pay what you must spend" as its core principle. Using public information as a zero-privacy prior, it charges the privacy budget only for the private increment. Specifically, SparsePay-RAG narrows the retrieval scope via public topic-guided clustering, adaptively controls private access frequency without privacy cost through isotonic cross-layer trajectory fitting, and compresses per-access budget via DP contrastive decoding. Under strong privacy constraints, experiments show SparsePay-RAG achieves superior privacy-utility trade-offs over baselines.
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Main
title_cn: 只付必需之费：差分隐私 RAG 的按需隐私预算支付
abstract_cn: 通过检索增强生成（RAG）在敏感数据上部署大语言模型会带来严重的隐私风险。近期研究对带 RAG 的 LLM 应用差分隐私（DP）以获得形式化隐私保证。然而现有 DP-RAG 框架会迅速耗尽隐私预算。尽管近期尝试通过收窄检索范围或稀疏化私有生成来节省预算，这些方法本身也在累积消耗预算，而其中许多操作本可只依赖公开信息或以可忽略的一次性隐私成本完成。这种错配使预算支出无法与模型对私有数据的实际依赖对齐，造成在不需要私有访问的操作上的大量浪费。为此，我们提出 SparsePay-RAG，以「只付必需之费」为核心原则：以公开信息作为零隐私先验，只对私有增量收取隐私预算。具体地，SparsePay-RAG 通过公开主题引导聚类收窄检索范围，通过等渗跨层轨迹拟合在不付出隐私成本的情况下自适应控制私有访问频率，并通过 DP 对比解码压缩每次访问的预算。在强隐私约束下的实验表明，SparsePay-RAG 取得优于基线的隐私-效用权衡。
summary_cn: 提出 SparsePay-RAG：只对私有增量支付隐私预算——公开主题聚类收窄检索、等渗轨迹拟合免成本控制访问频率、DP 对比解码压缩单次预算；强隐私约束下权衡优于基线。EMNLP 2026 主会录用。
objective_summary: 针对 DP-RAG 预算快速耗尽与实际私有依赖错配的问题，提出按私有增量计费的 SparsePay-RAG，由公开主题聚类、等渗跨层轨迹拟合与 DP 对比解码三个模块组成，并在强隐私约束下与基线比较隐私-效用权衡。
evidence_note: EMNLP 2026 主会录用，在强隐私约束下与多个基线系统对比；摘要未报告具体数据集规模、数值与统计检验。
novelty_note: DP-RAG 已有框架，新意在「只对私有增量计费」的预算会计原则及三个免/省预算模块的组合，属实质性机制改进。
scope: 结论适用于检索语料可区分公开/私有部分的 RAG 场景；对公开先验不可得或私有数据无主题结构的情形未验证。
limitations: 主题聚类质量影响检索收窄效果；等渗拟合依赖跨层轨迹的规律性假设；实验细节与消融规模摘要未披露。

title: Credible AUctions via MPC Gadgets: Bounding Information Leakage Under Abort
abstract: The design of credible auctions---mechanisms where a revenue-maximizing auctioneer has no incentive to deviate from the protocol---faces a fundamental cryptographic barrier when the auctioneer controls shill bidders. While a natural approach is to use Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) to remove the trusted auctioneer, the impossibility of fair coin flipping of Cleve (1986) implies that monolithic MPC protocols grant the auctioneer a "free option": they can learn the auction's outcome and unilaterally abort if the revenue is unsatisfactory. Cryptographic commitments with ex-ante penalties mitigate this abort asymmetry, but no finite penalty suffices for heavy-tailed distributions. We circumvent this barrier by introducing the MPC Decomposition Principle. Rather than encrypting the entire mechanism, we use MPC strictly as an information-restriction tool. We isolate the winner determination problem into a minimal MPC gadget that computes and reveals the winner's identity but no payment information. This qualitative restriction mathematically bounds the information leaked upon an abort. By combining this gadget with sequential revelation and finite economic penalties, we design the Sequential Revelation Auction (SRA). We prove that bounding the information leakage strictly bounds the value of the free option, showing that a penalty of $k \geq \sum_{i=1}^n Rev(F_i)$ is sufficient for credibility, and tight: for equal-revenue distributions, every smaller penalty admits a profitable deviation. Using constant-round MPC, the SRA resolves an open question of Akbarpour and Li (2020) and Ferreira and Weinberg (2020) by providing a constant-round, incentive-compatible, revenue-optimal credible auction for all product distributions with vanishing revenue tails
comment: 32 pages, AFT 2026
title_cn: 经由 MPC 小工具的可信拍卖：中止下信息泄露的界定
abstract_cn: 可信拍卖——收入最大化拍卖人没有偏离协议激励的机制——的设计面临一个根本性密码学障碍：当拍卖人控制托（shill）竞价者时。自然做法是用安全多方计算（MPC）去除可信拍卖人，但 Cleve（1986）公平抛硬币的不可能性意味着单体 MPC 协议给拍卖人留下「免费期权」：它可以获知拍卖结果并在收入不满意时单方面中止。带事前惩罚的密码学承诺可缓解这种中止不对称，但对重尾分布而言任何有限惩罚都不够。我们通过引入 MPC 分解原理绕过该障碍：与其加密整个机制，不如把 MPC 严格用作信息限制工具，把赢家确定问题隔离进一个最小 MPC 小工具——计算并揭示赢家身份但不泄露任何支付信息——这种定性限制在数学上界定了中止时泄露的信息。将该小工具与顺序揭示及有限经济惩罚结合，我们设计出顺序揭示拍卖（SRA），并证明界定信息泄露严格界定免费期权的价值：惩罚 k ≥ Σᵢ Rev(Fᵢ) 足以保证可信性且是紧的——对等收入分布，任何更小的惩罚都存在有利可图的偏离。借助常数轮 MPC，SRA 解决了 Akbarpour 与 Li（2020）以及 Ferreira 与 Weinberg（2020）的开放问题，为所有收入尾部消失的乘积分布提供常数轮、激励兼容、收入最优的可信拍卖。
summary_cn: 提出 MPC 分解原理：仅用最小 MPC 小工具揭示赢家身份以界定中止时的信息泄露，结合顺序揭示与有限惩罚设计出 SRA，证明惩罚 k ≥ Σᵢ Rev(Fᵢ) 充分且紧，并以常数轮 MPC 解决两个开放问题。
objective_summary: 针对可信拍卖中拍卖人控托与 MPC 免费期权的矛盾，提出 MPC 分解原理并设计顺序揭示拍卖 SRA，证明有限惩罚的可信性充分性与紧性，解决 Akbarpour–Li 与 Ferreira–Weinberg 的开放问题。
evidence_note: AFT 2026 录用；给出可信性的充分性证明与等收入分布下的紧性反例，解决两个已发表的开放问题，证明完整并达到紧界。
novelty_note: MPC 分解原理（以信息限制而非全机制加密的方式使用 MPC）是新路线，直接解决 2020 年两个开放问题并给出首个常数轮可信收入最优拍卖。
scope: 结论适用于收入尾部消失的乘积分布与常数轮 MPC 设定；对非乘积相关分布、合谋竞价者之外的策略行为及具体 MPC 实现开销未覆盖。
limitations: 可信性依赖惩罚机制的可执行性与事前可用性；小工具仍泄露赢家身份这一固有信息；常数轮 MPC 的实际通信成本未量化。

title: Seal, Then Sample: Sampled Layerwise Proofs for Verifiable LLM Inference from GPT-2 to 70B
abstract: Verifying outsourced language-model inference requires a precisely identified computation and an audit whose cost a service can afford. We present Sampled Layerwise Proofs (SLP), a protocol and prototype that commits the boundary activations of every chunk of an inference trace, absorbs all commitments before any challenge is drawn, and then proves a verifier-selected subset of chunks together with the chunks that bind the prompt and the answer. Audit coverage becomes a runtime parameter over one set of commitments: on a TinyLlama-1.1B trace, proving seven of 47 chunks takes 22.0% of the time and 6.8% of the proof size of proving all 47. Because proof cost is dominated by weights rather than tokens, SLP packs concurrent requests into one trace under a block-diagonal causal mask and binds the prompt and answer of each request to its slot. Twelve packed requests are proved in 181.9 s, 6.5 times less than twelve separate proofs at the measured single-proof cost, and a simulated service proves twelve requests at 30.6 s per request with 0.6 s of verification each, rejecting a tampered answer. Disk-backed integer weights and streamed polynomial commitments let a single Llama-2-70B run complete on a 2 TB CPU host: 163 chunks sealed, five proved, a 4.34 MiB proof in 1,259 s, verified in 46.3 s without the weights. The proven object is a fixed-point canonical model; we trace a severe fidelity loss to the residual-stream bit width, repair it with an LLM-aware observer, and measure 84.8-84.9% argmax agreement with the floating-point reference over 334,705 WikiText-2 test positions. The limits are stated as precisely: guarantees cover proven chunks only, a fixed invalid chunk in the 70B setting is covered with probability 3/161, a manifest-only Fiat-Shamir schedule can be ground at 12.5 ms per attempt and needs an externally ordered challenge, and all measurements use a test reference string.

title_cn: 先封样，再抽证：从 GPT-2 到 70B 的可验证 LLM 推理分层抽样证明
abstract_cn: 验证外包的语言模型推理需要精确界定被验证的计算，以及服务方能负担的审计成本。我们提出抽样分层证明（SLP）：一个协议与原型，对推理轨迹每个分块的边界激活做承诺，在任何挑战抽取前吸收全部承诺，然后只对验证方选定的分块子集及绑定提示与答案的分块出证明。审计覆盖率成为同一组承诺之上的运行时参数：在 TinyLlama-1.1B 轨迹上，证明 47 个分块中的 7 个只需全证明 22.0% 的时间与 6.8% 的证明体积。由于证明成本由权重而非 token 主导，SLP 在块对角因果掩码下把并发请求打包进同一条轨迹，并把每个请求的提示与答案绑定到其槽位：12 个打包请求 181.9 秒完成证明，比按测得单价分别证明 12 次节省 6.5 倍；一个模拟服务以每请求 30.6 秒证明、0.6 秒验证 12 个请求，并拒绝一个被篡改的答案。借助磁盘整数权重与流式多项式承诺，单次 Llama-2-70B 推理可在 2 TB CPU 主机完成：163 个分块封样、5 个出证、1,259 秒生成 4.34 MiB 证明，无需权重即可在 46.3 秒内验证。被证对象是定点规范化模型；我们把一次严重的保真度损失追溯到残差流位宽，用 LLM 感知观察器修复，并在 334,705 个 WikiText-2 测试位置测得与浮点参照 84.8–84.9% 的 argmax 一致性。界限被精确陈述：保证只覆盖被证分块；70B 设定下任一固定无效分块被覆盖的概率为 3/161；仅依赖清单的 Fiat-Shamir 调度可以 12.5 毫秒每次尝试被研磨、需要外部排序的挑战；所有测量使用测试参照串。
summary_cn: 提出抽样分层证明 SLP：分块承诺后只证验证方选定的子集，审计覆盖率成为运行时参数；TinyLlama 证 7/47 分块仅需 22.0% 时间，Llama-2-70B 证明 4.34 MiB、验证 46.3 秒。
objective_summary: 设计并实现可验证 LLM 推理协议 SLP：分块边界激活承诺+验证方抽样出证+请求打包共享一次证明，在 TinyLlama-1.1B 与 Llama-2-70B 上测量成本、保真度与安全界限。
evidence_note: 在两个真实模型与 2 TB CPU 主机上完成端到端原型测量并公开原始实验日志，拒绝篡改答案演示有效；但未与其他可验证推理方案做同基准对比。
novelty_note: 可验证推理已有大量工作，新意在把审计覆盖率做成同一承诺集上的运行时参数、块对角掩码打包多请求以及定点模型的保真度修正。
scope: 结论适用于 CPU 可承载的解码器式 LLM 推理审计；保证只覆盖被证分块与定点规范化模型，不覆盖浮点模型的位级一致或训练过程。
limitations: 固定无效分块在 70B 设定下的覆盖概率仅 3/161；Fiat-Shamir 调度可被研磨、需外部排序挑战；argmax 一致性 84.8–84.9% 意味着定点与浮点输出仍有差异。

title: Automated Extraction of Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) Using Hybrid RAG and Locally Deployed Large Language Models
abstract: Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 91/2025/QH15) and Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP, effective January 1, 2026, require organizations to establish and maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPA). Manual RoPA preparation is labor-intensive, while cloud-hosted large language models (LLMs) may conflict with data-sovereignty requirements. We propose RoPA Manager, a system for automated RoPA information extraction using hybrid retrieval that combines lexical ranking over tsvector, dense-vector search, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), and locally deployed LLMs. We introduce a Vietnamese RoPA benchmark with 32 organizations, 77 processing activities, 12 field groups, and 4,338 reference values. Evaluation is reported at three distinct levels. The automated scorer, tested on perturbed data without invoking an LLM, achieved F1 = 0.9493 [0.9436, 0.9548]; this measures scorer robustness rather than end-to-end extraction accuracy. End-to-end extraction achieved token coverage of 50.04-55.25% against the reference labels. Two independent experts reviewed 1,558 reference values (35.9% of the benchmark), found no incorrect values, and achieved 99.68% agreement with PABAK = 0.9936. Value-level precision was not measured. Across 32 paired scenarios on a 24 GB GPU, locally deployed Qwen3.5-27B-GPTQ-Int4 showed no statistically significant difference from cloud-based DeepSeek-V4-Flash (difference 0.20 percentage points in favor of DeepSeek, 95% CI [-0.93, 1.32], p = 0.72), while Gemma-4-31B performed significantly worse (p < 0.01).
comment: English version followed by Vietnamese version. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 29th National Conference on Selected Issues of Information and Communication Technology (VNICT 2026), Hanoi, Vietnam, November 7-8, 2026
title_cn: 基于混合 RAG 与本地部署大模型的处理活动记录自动抽取
abstract_cn: 越南《个人数据保护法》（第 91/2025/QH15 号法律）与第 356/2025/ND-CP 号议定自 2026 年 1 月 1 日生效，要求组织建立并维护处理活动记录（RoPA）。人工编制 RoPA 劳动密集，而云端托管大语言模型可能与数据主权要求冲突。我们提出 RoPA Manager，一个使用混合检索（tsvector 上的词法排序、稠密向量检索、倒数排名融合 RRF）与本地部署 LLM 的 RoPA 信息抽取系统。我们引入一个越南语 RoPA 基准，含 32 个组织、77 项处理活动、12 个字段组与 4,338 个参照值。评估在三个层面报告：在扰动数据上测试、不调用 LLM 的自动评分器取得 F1 = 0.9493 [0.9436, 0.9548]，这衡量的是评分器鲁棒性而非端到端抽取准确率；端到端抽取对参照标签的 token 覆盖率为 50.04–55.25%；两位独立专家复核 1,558 个参照值（占基准的 35.9%），未发现错误取值，与基准的一致性达 99.68%（PABAK = 0.9936）；取值级精确率未测量。在 24 GB GPU 上的 32 组配对场景中，本地部署的 Qwen3.5-27B-GPTQ-Int4 与云端 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 无统计显著差异（DeepSeek 高 0.20 个百分点，95% CI [-0.93, 1.32]，p = 0.72），而 Gemma-4-31B 显著更差（p < 0.01）。
summary_cn: 提出本地 LLM+混合 RAG 的 RoPA 合规抽取系统并发布 32 组织、4,338 参照值的越南语基准：端到端 token 覆盖率约 50–55%；本地 Qwen3.5-27B 与云端模型无显著差异（p = 0.72）。
objective_summary: 面向越南个人数据保护法的 RoPA 编制义务，构建混合检索+本地 LLM 的信息抽取系统 RoPA Manager，引入越南语 RoPA 基准并从评分器鲁棒性、端到端覆盖与专家复核三个层面评估本地与云端模型。
evidence_note: 基准含 32 组织 4,338 参照值，双专家复核 35.9% 并报告 PABAK 与置信区间、模型对比有统计检验；但端到端 token 覆盖率仅约五成且未测取值级精确率。
novelty_note: 合规文本抽取的组件（词法+稠密检索、RRF、本地 LLM）均为已有技术，新意在首个越南语 RoPA 基准与数据主权约束下的系统方案。
scope: 结论适用于越南语法律文书与 RoPA 字段抽取；对其他语言、其他合规文档类型与更大规模组织文档未验证。
limitations: 端到端 token 覆盖率仅 50–55%，取值级精确率未测量；基准与文档来自有限组织样本；本地模型结论限于 24 GB GPU 与被测三款模型。

title: SAGEGAN: Style-Based Anomaly Detection with Gaussian Embeddings using Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: Malware evolves faster than rule-based and signature-driven detection pipelines. This paper presents SAGEGAN, a benign-only trained malware anomaly detection framework that converts portable executable files into compact three-channel images and models benign structure through style-conditioned adversarial reconstruction. The representation combines Hilbert-mapped byte values, benign-referenced byte-transition surprise, and entropy deviation from benign software. The model encodes each image into a layer-wise style tensor aligned with a seven-stage modulated generator, rather than a single latent bottleneck. A Gaussian style prior, moment-based prior alignment, and latent consistency are used to reduce mismatch between encoded benign styles and the generator's sampled manifold. For interpretation, a deterministic encoder pathway maps each executable to a fixed style tensor, enabling repeatable layer-wise family distance, gradient sensitivity, principal component, and class-behaviour analyses. On a self-collected portable executable corpus containing malware from 214 families, the Gaussian variant achieves 89.76% area under the receiver operating characteristic curve and 88.19% balanced accuracy, while the genome-style variant reaches 88.03% and 84.09%, respectively. Without refitting model weights, benign reference statistics, or decision thresholds, the same checkpoints are evaluated on DIKE, Microsoft BIG 2015, and Lester malware subsets. The results suggest that layer-wise style modelling supports both anomaly ranking and structured post hoc analysis of how malware families depart from the benign manifold.
title_cn: SAGEGAN：基于生成对抗网络高斯嵌入的风格化异常检测
abstract_cn: 恶意软件的演化快于基于规则与签名的检测流水线。本文提出 SAGEGAN，一个仅用良性样本训练的恶意软件异常检测框架：把可执行文件（PE）转换为紧凑的三通道图像，并通过风格条件化对抗重建对良性结构建模。其表示结合 Hilbert 映射的字节值、以良性软件为参照的字节转移惊异与熵偏离。模型把每个图像编码为与七阶段调制生成器对齐的逐层风格张量，而非单一隐瓶颈；使用高斯风格先验、基于矩的先验对齐与隐一致性来缩小编码良性风格与生成器采样流形之间的失配。为便于解释，确定性编码器通路把每个可执行文件映射到固定风格张量，支持可复现的逐层家族距离、梯度敏感度、主成分与类行为分析。在含 214 个家族恶意软件的自建 PE 语料上，高斯变体取得 89.76% 的 ROC 曲线下面积与 88.19% 的平衡准确率，基因组风格变体分别为 88.03% 与 84.09%。在不重新拟合模型权重、良性参照统计或决策阈值的情况下，同一组检查点在 DIKE、Microsoft BIG 2015 与 Lester 恶意软件子集上评估。结果表明逐层风格建模既能支持异常排序，也能支持对恶意软件家族如何偏离良性流形的结构化事后分析。
summary_cn: 提出仅用良性样本训练的 SAGEGAN：PE 转三通道图像+七阶段调制生成器的逐层风格张量建模，214 家族自建语料上高斯变体 AUC 89.76%、平衡准确率 88.19%，检查点不重拟合即在 DIKE/BIG 2015/Lester 上跨库评估。
objective_summary: 提出以风格条件化对抗重建建模良性软件结构的恶意软件异常检测框架 SAGEGAN，用高斯风格先验与逐层风格张量支持异常排序与可复现的事后分析，并在自建 214 家族语料与三个外部子集上评估。
evidence_note: 214 家族自建语料加三个外部数据集的免重拟合跨库评估并报告 AUC 与平衡准确率，但无统计检验，与现有检测器的同等对比未报告。
novelty_note: 恶意软件图像化+GAN 重建已有先例，新意限于逐层风格张量与先验对齐的表示改造，属增量改进。
scope: 结论适用于 Windows PE 样本的家族无关异常检测；对强加壳/混淆样本、非 PE 平台与对抗性逃逸未评估。
limitations: 训练语料自建，与公开基准的可比性有限；图像表示丢失部分结构语义；跨库评估虽免重拟合但未覆盖时间外推的新家族。

title: Multi-View Fusion for Encrypted C2 Detection: A Leakage-Controlled Measurement Study of Evaluation Pitfalls
abstract: Command-and-control (C2) traffic increasingly hides within TLS, so defenders now apply machine learning to traffic metadata. Many studies assume that combining two metadata views, namely flow statistics and TLS handshake fingerprints, improves both accuracy and robustness. We tested this assumption on 17,577 TLS flows from 62 real Cobalt Strike captures. Our evaluation removes the data leakage that leads to overly optimistic reported scores. We report three findings that matter more than the fusion result itself. First, an incorrect preprocessing step increases the F1 score by 0.28. This step computes the frequency encoding across the entire dataset rather than within each cross-validation fold. The increase is about ten times larger than any real effect we measured. Second, both the labels and the behavioral features depend on the destination address. Because of this, the 17,577 flows form only 2,132 independent groups, and the positive rate of 55.1\%, which looks balanced, drops to 4.2\%. Therefore, class balance is just a result of how we analyze the data, specifically whether we count flows or endpoints, and not a real feature of the task. Third, 20 of the 62 captures (32\%) have no TLS flows to any known C2 address, so they contain only benign samples. We checked these captures directly and confirmed that this is a gap in the ground truth, not a labeling error. In this context, fusion beats the best single view by only 0.022 in F1. When an attacker forges both feature surfaces simultaneously, every model performs worse than a simple baseline that always predicts positive (F1 = 0.711). For encrypted C2 detection, the evaluation design is not a preliminary step. It \emph{is} the main result.

title_cn: 加密 C2 检测的多视图融合：一项控制数据泄漏的测量研究
abstract_cn: 命令与控制（C2）流量日益隐藏在 TLS 之中，防御者因此对流量元数据应用机器学习。许多研究假设组合流统计与 TLS 握手指纹两个元数据视图能同时提升准确率与鲁棒性。我们在来自 62 个真实 Cobalt Strike 捕获的 17,577 条 TLS 流上检验该假设。我们的评估剔除了导致报告分数过于乐观的数据泄漏。我们报告三个比融合结果本身更重要的发现。第一，一个错误的预处理步骤会使 F1 提高 0.28：该步骤在整个数据集而非每个交叉验证折内计算频率编码，其影响约为我们测得的任何真实效应的十倍。第二，标签与行为特征都依赖目标地址，因此 17,577 条流只构成 2,132 个独立组，看似均衡的 55.1% 正例率落到 4.2%；类均衡只是分析口径（按流还是按端点计数）的产物，并非任务的真实属性。第三，62 个捕获中的 20 个（32%）没有任何流向已知 C2 地址的 TLS 流，只含良性样本；我们直接核查确认这是 ground truth 缺口而非标注错误。在此背景下，融合仅比最佳单视图高 0.022 F1。当攻击者同时伪造两个特征面时，所有模型都不如总是预测正例的简单基线（F1 = 0.711）。对加密 C2 检测而言，评估设计不是前置步骤，它就是主要结果。
summary_cn: 对 62 个真实 Cobalt Strike 捕获的 17,577 条 TLS 流做去泄漏评估：错误频率编码虚增 F1 0.28，真实正例率仅 4.2%（独立组 2,132 个），多视图融合真实增益仅 0.022 F1。
objective_summary: 在 62 个真实 Cobalt Strike 捕获构成的 17,577 条 TLS 流上，控制数据泄漏后重新评估流统计与 TLS 握手指纹双视图融合对加密 C2 检测的增益，并系统量化预处理泄漏、分组独立性与标注缺口的扭曲效应。
evidence_note: 62 个真实恶意软件捕获、17,577 条流，逐一核查 ground truth 缺口来源，量化各扭曲效应（0.28 F1、2,132 独立组、4.2% 真实正例率），ASIANComNet 2026 录用。
novelty_note: 多视图融合检测本身无新意，价值在于首次在该任务上系统量化三类评估陷阱的量级，属于有诊断价值的实证修正。
scope: 结论适用于基于流量元数据的加密 C2 检测评估；对其他恶意流量任务需重新核查其独立组结构与标注完整性，但方法学结论可迁移。
limitations: 数据仅覆盖 Cobalt Strike 一种 C2 工具；融合结论受限于该数据集的 ground truth 缺口；未给出修正后的推荐评估流程的完整实现。

title: SoK: You Find What You Seek: Rethinking Oracles, Guidance, and Input Generation in Hardware Fuzzing
abstract: Hardware fuzzing is an active area in security verification research, yet its industrial adoption remains in its early stages. This SoK examines which lessons from software fuzzing carry over to hardware and where unique approaches are needed. By analyzing 52 fuzzers across RTL/IP, CPU, NoC, and SoC designs, we introduce an analytical framework that frames verification as a bounded search. This search is defined by its objective, oracle, guidance, input generation, target abstraction, and budget. Consequently, a campaign only uncovers failures it can effectively reach, recognize, and prioritize before exhausting its resources. We distinguish two roles for hardware fuzzing: (1) augmenting constrained-random verification (CRV) via feedback-guided coverage and (2) directed adversarial testing based on threat models and security specifications. Through our framework, we identify what each campaign can observe and generate, providing a basis for assessing the evidence behind reported results. Our analysis suggests that mainstream adoption of hardware fuzzing will require reusable interfaces, target-specific verification assets, reproducible evaluations, and transparent reporting of cost and user effort.
