However, we identify a critical security vulnerability in this setting: HE-LLM inference is vulnerable to malicious clients that submit adversarial prompts, such as jailbreak attacks. The same confidentiality that protects benign clients also prevents the server from inspecting incoming prompts or generated responses, making adversarial attempts difficult to detect or block and potentially allowing successful attacks to remain entirely invisible to the server. To address this vulnerability, we propose HE-Guardrail, a framework that evaluates guardrail mechanisms entirely over encrypted data and homomorphically controls whether the target-model response is returned to the client. We instantiate HE-Guardrail with three representative guardrails - Llama Guard, JBShield, and GradSafe. Our results show that HE-Guardrail closely reproduces the decisions of the corresponding plaintext guardrails in the encrypted domain, with distinct security-efficiency-utility trade-offs.
title_cn: HE-Guardrail：加密 LLM 推理中抗越狱的同态护栏
abstract_cn: 同态加密（HE）已成为隐私保护机器学习（PPML）的有望路径：直接在加密数据上计算。在基于 HE 的 PPML 中，客户端提交加密输入，服务器在无法接触明文的情况下评估 LLM 等模型。但我们识别出该设定中的关键安全漏洞：HE-LLM 推理对提交对抗提示（如越狱攻击）的恶意客户端脆弱。保护良性客户端的机密性同时阻止服务器检查入站提示与生成响应，使对抗尝试难以检测或阻断，成功攻击可能对服务器完全不可见。为此我们提出 HE-Guardrail：完全在加密数据上评估护栏机制、并同态地控制是否把目标模型响应返回给客户端的框架。我们以三个代表性护栏（Llama Guard、JBShield、GradSafe）实例化。结果显示 HE-Guardrail 在加密域中 closely 复现对应明文护栏的决策，呈现不同的安全-效率-效用权衡。
summary_cn: 发现加密 LLM 推理下「服务器无法审查提示」的越狱盲区，提出全同态护栏 HE-Guardrail：在密文域复现 Llama Guard 等三类护栏的决策。
objective_summary: 识别 HE-PPML 的越狱检测盲区并提出密文域护栏框架，以三个明文护栏为参照量化决策一致性。
evidence_note: 三护栏实例化、一致性对比与权衡报告；密文决策与明文的偏差分布、攻击覆盖与开销细节有限。
novelty_note: 把护栏计算同态化的系统方案较新；成本-精度权衡仍是该路线的根本约束。
scope: 结论适用于 HE 友好的护栏模型与文本分类型判断；对生成式护栏与复杂策略不适用。
limitations: 同态化的计算开销大；护栏自身攻击面（对抗明文与密文域差异）未深入；大规模部署可行性待验证。

title: DEFEAT: Stitching Fragmented File I/O Contexts for Early Ransomware Detection
abstract: Ransomware increasingly fragments its file operations across temporary and intermediate files, scattering the semantic context that links individual I/O events to an overarching encryption campaign. This fragmentation defeats existing detectors that reason over isolated file streams -- whether pattern-based methods that match rigid event sequences or learning-based methods that require accumulating statistical evidence across many files. We present DEFEAT, a framework that reconstructs this fragmented, scattered context by grouping causally related file events into File Event Gadgets (FEGs), semantically coherent units that capture the full intent behind sequences of file operations spanning multiple dynamically created files. Unlike provenance graphs (system-wide causal graphs that record relationships among all OS entities, such as processes, files, sockets, and registry keys, across the entire system), FEGs are scoped to the file-operation context of a single user asset, enabling lightweight, targeted analysis without whole-system instrumentation. Each FEG is modelled as an attributed control flow graph (ACFG) and embedded via a graph neural network for unsupervised clustering, enabling analysts to label entire behavioural clusters rather than individual samples, reducing annotation effort by 94%. Evaluated on a corpus of 97,816,471 file I/O events spanning 67 ransomware families, DEFEAT achieves 99.2% detection accuracy and outperforms state-of-the-art methods including UNVEIL, RWGuard, and Peeler by 6.57 to 7.56%. The framework operates at the granularity of a single file encryption: because each ACFG represents exactly one FEG (one user asset context), a cluster label can be assigned as soon as the first file operation completes, enabling detection at the first encrypted file.
comment: 13 pages. Accepted to the 42nd Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC 2026)
title_cn: DEFEAT：拼接碎片化的文件 I/O 上下文以实现勒索软件早期检测
abstract_cn: 勒索软件日益把文件操作碎片化到临时与中间文件中，把「单个 I/O 事件与整体加密活动」关联起来的语义上下文打散。这种碎片化击败了在孤立文件流上推理的现有检测器——无论匹配僵化事件序列的模式方法，还是需要跨大量文件累积统计证据的学习方法。我们提出 DEFEAT：把因果相关的文件事件分组为「文件事件小工具」（FEG）——语义连贯的单位，捕捉跨多个动态创建文件的文件操作序列背后的完整意图。与溯源图（记录全系统所有 OS 实体关系的因果图）不同，FEG 限定在单个用户资产的文件操作上下文内，实现轻量、有针对性的分析而无需全系统插桩。每个 FEG 被建模为属性控制流图（ACFG），经图神经网络嵌入做无监督聚类，使分析师标注整个行为簇而非单个样本，标注工作量减少 94%。在横跨 67 个勒索软件家族、97,816,471 个文件 I/O 事件的语料上，DEFEAT 达到 99.2% 检测准确率，超过 UNVEIL、RWGuard 与 Peeler 等 SOTA 6.57–7.56 个百分点。框架工作在单文件加密粒度：每个 ACFG 恰对应一个 FEG（一个用户资产上下文），首个文件操作完成即可赋予簇标签，实现「第一个加密文件即检测」（ACSAC 2026）。
summary_cn: 以「文件事件小工具」为单位重建被勒索软件碎片化的 I/O 上下文：67 家族 9,700 万事件语料上 99.2% 准确率、超 SOTA 6.6–7.6 点，首个加密文件即报警（ACSAC 2026）。
objective_summary: 提出文件事件小工具抽象与 GNN 聚类检测框架，在超大规模真实语料上验证早期检测能力并对比 SOTA。
evidence_note: 67 家族、9,780 万事件的语料、三个 SOTA 对比、ACSAC 录用；单资产范围的抽象可能漏跨资产攻击链。
novelty_note: FEG 抽象精准回应「操作碎片化」这一真实演进，兼顾早期性与轻量性，是对溯源图路线的实质改进。
scope: 结论适用于 Windows 文件系统勒索行为与所测 67 家族；对非文件面攻击与云同步场景未覆盖。
limitations: 语料时点与家族代表性；GNN 聚类标注仍需人工校准；对慢速/低频加密的敏感性未详。

title: TrustBOM: A Scalable Architecture for Confidentiality-Preserving SBOMs Across Organizations
abstract: Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) have emerged as a key mechanism for software supply chain governance in enterprise architectures. However, their adoption across organizations remains limited due to concerns about exposing sensitive dependency information. To address this limitation, we propose TrustBOM, a scalable architecture for confidentiality-preserving SBOMs integrated into enterprise CI/CD workflows. TrustBOM enables software providers to attest that specific vulnerabilities or restricted licenses are absent from their software without revealing the underlying dependency graph. This is achieved using zero-knowledge non-membership proofs, which are applied selectively based on consumer-defined policy constraints. The architecture ensures that proof generation scales linearly with the number of asserted constraints rather than with the size of the SBOM, enabling efficient operation in large-scale enterprise environments. Empirical evaluation demonstrates linear performance, with an average proof generation time of 0.9 seconds per constraint on commodity hardware, indicating the feasibility of deployment in enterprise platform ecosystems.
comment: This work has been accepted to the 30th International Conference on Enterprise Design, Operations, and Computing (EDOC 2026)
title_cn: TrustBOM：跨组织保密 SBOM 的可扩展架构
abstract_cn: 软件物料清单（SBOM）已成为企业架构中软件供应链治理的关键机制，但因担心暴露敏感依赖信息，跨组织采用仍受限。为此我们提出 TrustBOM：一个集成进企业 CI/CD 工作流的可扩展保密 SBOM 架构。TrustBOM 让软件提供方证明其软件不含特定漏洞或受限许可证，而不暴露底层依赖图：以零知识非成员证明实现，并按消费者定义的策略约束选择性应用。架构保证证明生成的开销随「被断言约束数」线性增长而非随 SBOM 大小，使其能在大规模企业环境高效运行。实证评估显示线性性能，商品硬件上每约束平均证明生成 0.9 秒，表明在企业平台生态部署可行（EDOC 2026）。
summary_cn: 以零知识非成员证明实现「证明无漏洞/无受限许可但不给依赖图」的 SBOM 架构：开销随约束数线性（每约束 0.9 秒），集成企业 CI/CD（EDOC 2026）。
objective_summary: 设计并评估基于 ZK 非成员证明的保密 SBOM 架构，量化证明开销的线性可扩展性。
evidence_note: 有实现与性能评估、会议录用；攻击者模型与证明可靠性依赖 ZK 库正确性，跨组织实战部署未报告。
novelty_note: 把 ZK 非成员证明对准 SBOM 治理的真实摩擦点（保密 vs. 可验证），场景结合较新。
scope: 结论适用于承诺式断言（不含 X）的治理场景；对完整依赖图审计需求不适用。
limitations: 仅支持否定式断言；证明密钥管理与版本更新复杂；监管口径认可待验证。

title: Batched Paillier-Based Hamming-Distance Computation over Binary Embeddings
abstract: Additively homomorphic encryption supports outsourced computation on encrypted binary embeddings, but large-integer arithmetic and data movement can limit throughput. We describe a Paillier-based client that combines a carry-separated binary encoding, table-based encryption, reduced-exponent decryption, CUDA/CGBN arithmetic, persistent device state, and batched retrieval integration. We establish the encoding's correctness and characterize four CPU and GPU client configurations. The lookup configuration uses a 280-bit exponent-size parameter. Across 3 warm-state trials on batches of 10,000 random 512-bit embeddings, the lookup GPU configuration achieved median-batch throughputs of 43,091 encryptions/s and 28,983 Hamming- distance decodes/s. Its amortized costs were 0.0232 ms and 0.0345 ms per vector, corresponding to factors of 453.8 and 200.9 relative to the measured CPU baseline. These implementation- specific results demonstrate the throughput benefits of combining cryptographic precomputation, batched accelerator execution, and persistent runtime state. The study distinguishes warm-batch performance from isolated-request latency and identifies the remaining costs of initialization, transport, and retrieval integration.
title_cn: 基于批量 Paillier 的二进制嵌入汉明距离计算
abstract_cn: 加性同态加密支持在加密二进制嵌入上外包计算，但大整数算术与数据搬运限制吞吐。我们描述一个基于 Paillier 的客户端，组合进位分离的二进制编码、查表加密、降指数解密、CUDA/CGBN 算术、持久设备状态与批量检索集成。我们确立编码的正确性并刻画四种 CPU/GPU 客户端配置。查找配置使用 280 位的指数尺寸参数。在 10,000 个随机 512 位嵌入的批量、三次暖态试验中，查找 GPU 配置达到中位批量吞吐 43,091 次加密/秒与 28,983 次汉明距离解码/秒；摊销成本每向量 0.0232/0.0345 毫秒，相对实测 CPU 基线分别提升 453.8 倍与 200.9 倍。这些实现特定的结果展示了密码预计算、批量加速执行与持久运行时状态结合的吞吐收益。研究区分暖态批量性能与孤立请求延迟，并指出初始化、传输与检索集成仍存的成本。
summary_cn: Paillier 加密二进制嵌入汉明距离的 GPU 批量实现：1 万向量批次吞吐 4.3 万加密/秒、较 CPU 基线提升 200–450 倍（实现研究，暖态口径）。
objective_summary: 给出加密嵌入相似度计算的工程优化组合与吞吐测量，区分暖态与冷态成本。
evidence_note: 配置刻画完整、基线对比明确、三次试验报告中位数；实现特定、无安全新意，参数选择（280 位指数）需按场景评估。
novelty_note: 编码与优化多为已知技术的工程组合；系统化的暖态测量口径有小贡献。
scope: 结论限于 Paillier/512 位嵌入/所选 GPU 配置；对其他同态方案与模型不外推。
limitations: 安全性依赖参数选择；冷态延迟仍高；与更现代方案（如 CKKS/OT）缺横向对比。

title: CESBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Cryptographic Engineering Security for IoT Devices
abstract: For Internet of Things (IoT) devices, a secure algorithm alone is not enough: an attacker with physical access can attack the implementation directly, and its flaws are hard to fix once deployed. Large language models (LLMs) are now used to build and analyze such implementations. LLM benchmarks exist for cryptography and general cybersecurity, but none covers cryptographic engineering. In this paper, we present CESBench, 380 expert-written items across six sub-domains of cryptographic engineering security for IoT devices: side-channel, fault injection, implementation, countermeasures, evaluation, and integration. Four task types target different competences: 209 multiple-choice items test recall, 67 judgment items require a security verdict and its justification, 63 scenario items require an engineering diagnosis, and 41 code tasks are graded by 572 test cases. To validate the benchmark, 11 open-weight and proprietary LLMs answer every item. Multiple-choice and code responses are scored automatically, and judgment and scenario responses by an LLM judge, whose scores are checked against a second judge from another model family and human re-scoring. Composite scores range from 54.4% to 83.6%. The top score on each task type is 98.6% for multiple choice, 95.1% for code, and 88.4% for scenario diagnosis, but only 58.8% for judgment. Across models, 88.5% of verdicts are correct, yet their justifications earn only 53.4% of the rubric marks. Multiple choice is near its ceiling for the strongest models and most code tasks are solved, whereas justifying a security verdict remains the weakest competence. The benchmark, prompts, and per-item results are public.
title_cn: CESBench：在 IoT 设备密码工程安全上评测大语言模型
abstract_cn: 对 IoT 设备，算法安全还不够：有物理接触的攻击者可以直接攻击实现，而实现的缺陷一旦部署难以修复。LLM 如今被用于构建与分析这类实现。已有面向密码学与一般网络安全的 LLM 基准，但没有覆盖密码工程。我们提出 CESBench：380 个专家撰写的条目，覆盖 IoT 设备密码工程安全的六个子域——侧信道、故障注入、实现、对策、评估与集成。四种任务类型对应不同能力：209 道多选测记忆、67 道判断题要求安全裁决及理由、63 道场景题要求工程诊断、41 道代码任务由 572 个测试用例评分。为验证基准，11 个开放权重与专有 LLM 作答全部条目；多选与代码自动评分，判断与场景由 LLM 裁判评分并经另一模型族的第二裁判与人工重评校验。综合得分 54.4%–83.6%；各任务类型最高分为：多选 98.6%、代码 95.1%、场景诊断 88.4%，但判断题仅 58.8%。跨模型 88.5% 的裁决正确，但其理由只拿到 53.4% 的量规分。强模型多选近天花板、多数代码任务可解，而为安全裁决给出理由仍是最弱的能力。基准、提示与逐条结果公开。
summary_cn: 380 道专家题的密码工程安全基准（侧信道/故障注入/实现/对策/评估/集成）：11 个 LLM 综合分 54–84%，判断题仅 58.8%，裁决理由得分率 53.4% 为最弱能力。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖 IoT 密码工程六子域的专家基准，系统评测 11 个 LLM 并以双重裁判与人工重评校验。
evidence_note: 380 条目、专家撰写、572 测试用例、11 模型全量作答、跨族裁判 + 人工校验、全量公开；评委偏差仍可能有残余。
novelty_note: 首个覆盖「密码工程」（实现侧）的 LLM 基准，任务类型与能力映射设计完整。
scope: 结论适用于所测模型与 IoT 密码工程领域；随模型迭代需持续更新。
limitations: LLM 裁判的残余偏差；条目静态、可能被训练记忆；对 agentic 工具辅助作答未覆盖。

title: Conformal Privacy Auditing: Calibrated Re-identification Attacks with Statistical Guarantees
abstract: Empirical identity leakage from released text is increasingly driven by attackers that combine large language models (LLMs) with auxiliary knowledge to link documents to individuals. Existing audits typically report success rates for specific attack pipelines but lack finite-sample statistical guarantees, while training-time protections such as differential privacy are difficult to translate into release-time decisions for individual natural-language documents. We introduce Conformal Privacy Auditing(CPA), a distribution-free calibration framework that provides a statistical certificate of re-identification risk for each released document against LLM-empowered adversaries. CPA outputs a conformal ambiguity set of candidate identities that is guaranteed to contain the true identity with user-chosen confidence under exchangeability, together with an interpretable leakage proxy derived from set size. CPA supports both logit-access and sampling-only attackers, enabling audits of open-source models and proprietary API models in a unified framework. Across multiple release benchmarks and attacker configurations, CPA achieves calibrated coverage and reveals sharp shifts in certified identifiability as auxiliary knowledge, LLM augmentation, and release mechanisms vary, providing a statistically grounded basis for reporting and comparing release-time linkage risk across attacker configurations, datasets, and release mechanisms alike.
title_cn: 共形隐私审计：带统计保证的校准重识别攻击
abstract_cn: 发布文本的经验身份泄露日益由「LLM + 辅助知识」把文档关联到个人的攻击者驱动。现有审计通常只报告特定攻击管线的成功率，缺乏有限样本统计保证；而差分隐私等训练期保护难以转化为对单篇自然语言文档的发布期决策。我们提出 Conformal Privacy Auditing（CPA）：一个无分布假设的校准框架，针对 LLM 赋能的对手为每篇发布文档提供重识别风险的统计证书。CPA 输出一个共形歧义集（候选身份集合），在可交换性下以用户选择的置信度保证包含真实身份，并给出由集合大小导出的可解释泄露代理。CPA 同时支持有 logit 访问与仅采样的攻击者，统一审计开源与专有 API 模型。跨多个发布基准与攻击者配置，CPA 实现校准覆盖，并揭示认证可识别性随辅助知识、LLM 增强与发布机制变化的急剧转变，为跨攻击者配置、数据集与发布机制报告和比较发布期关联风险提供统计基础。
summary_cn: 以共形预测给每篇发布文档输出「保证含真实身份的候选集」：统一审计 LLM 赋能重识别攻击的统计框架，覆盖与泄露代理可校准。
objective_summary: 把共形校准引入发布期重识别风险审计，给出带有限样本保证的候选集度量并跨配置验证覆盖。
evidence_note: 多基准多攻击者配置的校准覆盖验证；可交换性假设在自适应发布下可能不成立，攻击族覆盖有限。
novelty_note: 把共形预测用于单文档级隐私证书是清晰的跨域组合；对手能力仍以查询式为主。
scope: 结论在可交换性成立的场景有效；对分布漂移的发布流程需重校准。
limitations: 攻击族代表性；证书解读依赖置信度选择；计算成本随候选集增长。

title: Identifying Security Platform Product Abuse with Machine Learning
abstract: Product abuse is an individually rare, but growing, problem across the SaaS industry. Highly sophisticated threat actors can misuse security platforms within customer environments or conduct bypass experiments on the product itself. Threat actors can leverage living-off-the-land (LOTL) attacks to avoid using cumbersome, frequently detected malware. Remediating this threat requires collecting multiple data modalities across different types of databases, addressing a cold-start problem in the intrinsic rarity of such sophisticated but dangerous events, and designing within the constraints of real-world deployment (e.g., cost, user behavior, performance, etc). To wit, we provide the first study of such a whole-system defense, especially with respect to a deployed and operational capability. Our results show an increase in product abuse coverage by 35\%, a 30\% reduction in monthly alerts, and adaptability to changes in malicious actors' behavior. We review both the constraints we considered in designing the system to meet operational requirements and a retrospective evaluation of the value of explainable features and counterfactual performance on previously identified attacks.
comment: To appear in The 13th IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Advanced Analytics (DSAA 2026)
title_cn: 用机器学习识别安全平台产品滥用
abstract_cn: 产品滥用在 SaaS 行业中单例稀有但持续增长。高度复杂的威胁行为者可在客户环境内滥用安全平台，或对产品本身进行绕过实验；并借助 living-off-the-land（LOTL）攻击避开笨重且常被检出的恶意软件。应对需要跨多类数据库收集多种数据模态、应对此类稀有危险事件固有的冷启动问题，并在真实部署约束（成本、用户行为、性能等）内设计。我们提供此类整体防御的首个研究，尤其针对已部署且在运营中的能力。结果显示：产品滥用覆盖率提升 35%、月度告警减少 30%，并能适应恶意行为者行为变化。我们检视设计系统以满足运营需求时考虑的约束，并对可解释特征的价值与既有攻击上的反事实表现做了回溯评估（DSAA 2026）。
summary_cn: 工业界已部署的整体防御系统研究：多模态 ML 识别安全平台自身被滥用，覆盖率 +35%、月告警 −30%，并做反事实回溯（DSAA 2026，专有遥测）。
objective_summary: 报告已部署的产品滥用检测系统的设计约束、运营指标与回溯评估。
evidence_note: 真实部署与运营指标、回溯反事实评估；数据专有不可复现、基线与统计细节受限。
novelty_note: 「安全平台自身被滥用」的视角与整体防御系统的部署级报告在公开文献中少见。
scope: 结论适用于该厂商平台的遥测与客户环境；跨平台外推有限。
limitations: 不可复现；攻击标签的 ground truth 依赖内部流程；成本-收益的长期观测缺失。

title: Authorization Revocation for Long-Running AI Agents: Root-Scoped Quiescence under Delegation and Asynchronous Execution
abstract: Long-running AI agents outlive initiating processes through credentials, delegated tasks, queues, callbacks, reservations, and provider-side operations. Cancellation, process exit, and credential revocation neither close every pre-cut carrier nor distinguish independently authorized shared work. We define root-scoped authorization quiescence: for each manifested sink, a certificate accounts for every cut-relevant acceptance under the retired root-epoch atom that precedes its local fence and excludes protected acceptance under that atom after the fence, while permitting exact rebind to a current, independently sufficient support. The root-scoped quiescence protocol linearizes a root cut, fences old-root expansion and protected sinks, represents alternative and conjunctive authority as antichains of minimal sufficient root sets, and composes provider-frontier certificates into a cutset over registered old-root paths. Exact channel-token accounting reconciles transfers; missing or conflicting evidence remains indeterminate. Under stated assumptions, we prove post-cut issuer non-expansion, support-sound projection, compositional soundness under exact channel conservation, independent-support preservation, merge-order independence, and crash/replay stability. A provider-free late-effect test suite matches 17/17 registered outcomes. Two cancellation-only and one cut-only execution accept the same class of already scheduled late effect; two cut-plus-fence executions, one restart, and one stale-process execution reject it. A separately implemented checker verifies 17/17 traces and rejects 44/44 consistently rehashed semantic regressions. The certificate establishes root-relative authorization quiescence within its bound manifest and configuration, not global idleness, rollback, or business completion.
comment: 39 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables; includes a complete proof appendix
title_cn: 长时程 AI 智能体的授权撤销：委托与异步执行下的根范围静默
abstract_cn: 长时程 AI 智能体经由凭证、受托任务、队列、回调、预订与提供方侧操作而比发起进程活得更久。取消、进程退出与凭证撤销既不能关闭每一个预先切断的载体，也无法区分独立授权的共享工作。我们定义根范围授权静默：对每个已显现的汇点，一份证书对其在退役根原子下、局部栅栏之前的每个与切断相关的接受负责，排除栅栏之后受该原子保护的接受，同时允许向当前、独立充分的支持做精确重绑。根范围静默协议线性化根切断、栅栏旧根扩展与受保护汇点、把替代与合取权威表示为最小充分根集的反链、并把提供方边界证书组合成已注册旧根路径上的割集；精确的通道令牌核算调和转移，缺失或冲突的证据保持未定。在给定假设下，我们证明切断后签发者不扩展、支持可靠投影、精确通道守恒下的组合可靠性、独立支持保持、合并序独立与崩溃/重放稳定性。无提供方的晚效应测试套件匹配 17/17 已注册结果；两个仅取消与一个仅切断的执行接受同类已排期晚效应，两个切断加栅栏、一个重启与一个过期进程执行拒绝之。独立实现的检查器核验 17/17 轨迹并一致拒绝 44/44 语义回归。证书确立的是其界限清单与配置内相对根的授权静默，而非全局闲置、回滚或业务完成。
summary_cn: 形式化长时程智能体的「授权静默」问题并给出根范围静默协议：完整证明附录 + 17/17 测试套件与独立检查器核验，处理委托/异步/晚效应下的撤销闭环。
objective_summary: 定义并解决长时程智能体授权撤销的静默性问题：形式模型、协议、证明与可复验测试套件。
evidence_note: 完整证明 + 独立实现的检查器核验 17/17 轨迹、44/44 回归拒绝；真实提供方生态验证缺失。
novelty_note: 把分布式系统的 cut/fence 思想系统迁移到智能体授权撤销是新场景化的实质理论贡献，表述高度形式化。
scope: 结论在所列假设（证书、登记路径、令牌核算）内成立；对绕过登记的载体不提供保证。
limitations: 模型复杂、工程采用门槛高；对提供方合作的现实可得性依赖；证书管理的运维成本未评估。

title: Transcript-Bound Combiners for Downgrade-Resilient Hybrid Post-Quantum Key Establishment: Definition, Proof, and Embedded-Device Cost
abstract: Hybrid key establishment runs a post-quantum key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM) alongside a classical Diffie-Hellman primitive, so that the session key stays secure while either component resists attack. This design is now standardized in the Transport Layer Security protocol, Secure Shell, and the Internet Key Exchange, with the standardized module-lattice KEM (ML-KEM) as the post-quantum component. A hybrid KEM secures the derived key, but not the integrity of the negotiation that selects which primitives are used. Full protocols authenticate that negotiation through a handshake transcript; a hybrid KEM deployed as a standalone drop-in primitive, or inside a minimal handshake without transcript authentication, inherits no such guarantee, and an active attacker can strip the post-quantum option. We ask what the key schedule alone must contain to make downgrade resilience a local property of the combiner. We give a game-based definition at the combiner layer and prove a two-sided separation: a combiner that ignores the transcript is downgraded with certainty, whereas one that binds the session key and the confirmation tag to a hash of the transcript blocks every such attempt, up to a term negligible for a 256-bit transcript hash. We also give an explicit strongest-link security bound. Using a calibrated cost model composed from published Cortex-M4 measurements, transcript binding adds one hash per party - about 11.8% of handshake computation but only 1.5% of radio-inclusive energy - and adds no messages or bytes on the wire. Every reported number is produced by a released harness that passes a 30-check validation gate.
title_cn: 绑定会话抄本的抗降级混合后量子密钥建立组合器：定义、证明与嵌入式成本
abstract_cn: 混合密钥建立让后量子 KEM 与经典 Diffie-Hellman 并行运行，只要任一组件抗攻击，会话密钥就保持安全。该设计已标准化于 TLS、SSH 与 IKE，以后量子组件为模块格 KEM（ML-KEM）。混合 KEM 保护派生密钥，却不保护选择所用原语的协商完整性。完整协议经握手抄本认证该协商；而作为独立即插组件、或在无抄本认证的极简握手中部署的混合 KEM 不继承该保证，主动攻击者可剥离后量子选项。我们问：密钥调度本身必须包含什么，才能使降级韧性成为组合器的局部性质。我们给出组合器层的博弈式定义并证明双边分离：忽略抄本的组合器必然被降级；而把会话密钥与确认标签绑定到抄本哈希的组合器可阻断一切此类尝试（对 256 位抄本哈希该项可忽略）。我们并给出显式的最强环节安全界。用经校准的 Cortex-M4 公开测量成本模型估计：抄本绑定每方只增加一次哈希——约占握手计算 11.8%、含射频能耗仅 1.5%，且不增加任何线上消息或字节。所有数字由通过 30 项校验门的公开 harness 产出。
summary_cn: 在组合器层定义并证明「抄本绑定 ⇒ 抗降级」的双边分离：成本仅每方一次哈希（握手计算 11.8%、射频能耗 1.5%、零额外字节），估值 harness 公开。
objective_summary: 给出抗降级组合器的博弈式定义与分离证明，并以嵌入式成本模型量化抄本绑定的开销。
evidence_note: 博弈式定义 + 证明 + 经校验 harness 的成本建模，方法严谨；成本为模型估计而非自测硬件。
novelty_note: 把降级韧性定位为组合器局部性质并给出最小充分机制（一次哈希）是清晰的概念贡献。
scope: 结论适用于密钥调度可修改的协议栈；对无法改调度的既有部署需协议层改法。
limitations: 成本模型依赖公开测量校准；未覆盖协议消息流层的降级向量。

title: Combining Exploratory Analysis and Automated Analysis for Anomaly Detection in Real-Time Data Streams
abstract: Security analysts can become overwhelmed with monitoring real-time security information that is important to help them defend their network. They also tend to focus on a limited portion of the alerts, and therefore risk missing important events and links between them. At the heart of the problem is the system that analysts use to detect, explore, and respond to cyber-attacks. Developers of security analysis systems face the challenge of developing a system that can present different sources of information at multiple levels of abstraction, while also creating a system that is intuitive to use. In this article, we examine the complementary nature of exploratory analysis and automated analysis by testing the development of a system that monitors real-time Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) traffic for anomalies that might indicate security threats. BGP is an essential component for supporting the infrastructure of the Internet; however, it is also highly vulnerable and can be hijacked by attackers to propagate spam or launch denial-of-service attacks. Some of the attack scenarios on the BGP infrastructure can be quite elaborate, and it is difficult, if not impossible, to fully automate the detection of such attacks. This article makes two contributions: i) it describes a prototype platform for computing indicators and threat alerts in real time and for visualizing the context of an alert, and ii) it discusses the interaction of exploratory analysis (visualization) and automated analysis. This article is relevant to students, security researchers, and developers who are interested in the development or use of real-time security monitoring systems. They will gain insights into the complementary aspects of automated analysis and exploratory analysis through the development of a real-time streaming system.
title_cn: 结合探索性分析与自动化分析检测实时数据流异常
abstract_cn: 安全分析师在监控对防御网络重要的实时安全信息时可能不堪重负；他们往往只关注有限的告警子集，因而有漏掉重要事件及其关联的风险。问题核心在于分析师用来检测、探索与响应网络攻击的系统。安全分析系统的开发者面临双重挑战：在多个抽象层次呈现不同信息源，同时保持系统直观易用。本文通过测试一个监控实时 BGP 流量异常（可能指示安全威胁）的系统开发，检视探索性分析与自动化分析的互补性。BGP 是支撑互联网基础设施的关键组件，但也高度脆弱，可被攻击者劫持以传播垃圾流量或发起拒绝服务。BGP 基础设施的某些攻击场景相当复杂，完全自动化检测即使可能也极为困难。本文两点贡献：一，描述一个实时计算指标与威胁告警、并可视化告警上下文的原型平台；二，讨论探索性分析（可视化）与自动化分析的交互。对有意开发或使用实时安全监控系统的学生、安全研究者与开发者，可从该实时流系统的开发中获得两类分析互补性的洞见。
summary_cn: 面向 BGP 异构威胁的实时监控原型平台：可视化探索与自动化分析互补的设计经验与交互讨论（原型系统文章，无系统评估）。
objective_summary: 描述 BGP 实时异常监控原型平台并探讨探索性与自动化分析的互补设计。
evidence_note: 有原型实现与设计讨论，但无受控评估、检测效果量化或用户研究。
novelty_note: 可视化与自动化分析结合在安全运营领域已有较长传统，贡献偏经验总结。
scope: 经验适用于 BGP/路由类流数据的监控界面与流程设计。
limitations: 无量化评估；平台成熟度与部署反馈不明；攻击场景覆盖有限。

title: X-SPUR: Explainable Surprisal-Based Protocol-Aware Unsupervised Reasoning for Automotive Ethernet Intrusion Detection
abstract: Automotive Ethernet carries heterogeneous multi-protocol traffic in modern in-vehicle networks, where labeled attack data are rarely available and the strongest prior unsupervised detector still relies on handcrafted traffic features. This article presents X-SPUR, an explainable, surprisal-based, protocol-aware unsupervised reasoning framework that instead represents raw packet fields as token sequences, learns benign traffic patterns through causal language modeling, and detects anomalies from per-token cross-entropy surprisal. To incorporate temporal context, we introduce a bimodal fusion architecture that combines payload-token embeddings with inter-packet timing through additive fusion and a Hadamard interaction. To handle the heterogeneous score distributions of different protocol families, we further propose a dual top-$k$% per-protocol $Z$-score calibration that jointly captures moderately distributed and sparse anomaly signatures. On the TOW-IDS dataset, X-SPUR achieves an AUC of 0.9987. This is marginally higher than the 0.9969 reported for AERO. X-SPUR also eliminates handcrafted feature engineering. We train a separate CarDS model using the same architecture and training hyperparameters. This model retains strong performance on the second automotive Ethernet dataset. Beyond detection, per-token surprisal provides fine-grained explainability by attributing anomaly scores to specific protocol fields, supporting interpretable security analysis in heterogeneous in-vehicle networks.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. This article has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics. This is the author's accepted manuscript
title_cn: X-SPUR：面向车载以太网入侵检测的可解释基于惊奇度的协议感知无监督推理
abstract_cn: 车载以太网在现代车内网络承载异构多协议流量，带标签攻击数据稀缺，而此前最强的无监督检测器仍依赖手工流量特征。本文提出 X-SPUR：一个可解释、基于惊奇度、协议感知的无监督推理框架，把原始数据包字段表示为 token 序列，经因果语言建模学习良性流量模式，并从逐 token 交叉熵惊奇度检测异常。为纳入时间上下文，我们引入双模态融合架构，通过加性融合与 Hadamard 交互结合载荷 token 嵌入与包间时间。为处理不同协议族的异构分数分布，我们提出按协议的双 top-k% Z-score 校准，同时捕捉中等分布与稀疏的异常签名。在 TOW-IDS 数据集上 X-SPUR 达到 AUC 0.9987，略高于 AERO 报告的 0.9969，并免除了手工特征工程。用同一架构与超参训练的 CarDS 模型在第二个车载以太网数据集上保持强性能。逐 token 惊奇度还提供细粒度可解释性——把异常分归因到具体协议字段，支持异构车内网络的可解释安全分析（IEEE TII 录用）。
summary_cn: 把车载以太网报文字段当作 token 序列做因果语言建模、以逐 token 惊奇度做无监督入侵检测：TOW-IDS 上 AUC 0.9987（超 AERO），免手工特征且可归因到字段。
objective_summary: 提出协议感知的语言建模式无监督入侵检测框架，在两个车载以太网数据集上验证检测与可解释性。
evidence_note: 两个数据集、与 SOTA AERO 对比、期刊录用；公开数据集局限、无统计检验，跨数据集用同架构重训而非零迁移。
novelty_note: 把因果 LM 惊奇度用于车载多协议流量并结合协议级校准，组合有新意；语言建模异常检测思想有先例。
scope: 结论适用于车载以太网捕获数据与所测攻击类型；对实车时延约束与在线部署未验证。
limitations: 公开数据集与现实攻击差距；语言模型推理开销对车载资源的影响未讨论；时间融合的超参敏感性。

title: Toss If Perishable: An Ethnographic Study on Building Scenario-Based Training for Non-Perishable Skills
abstract: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) often rely upon on-the-job training focusing on the specific tools and procedures a SOC utilizes. The complexity in tooling can overshadow the underlying reasoning process, hindering an analyst's ability to learn investigative skills. We formulate the concept of "non-perishable knowledge" which corresponds to investigative thinking skills independent of tools. We developed a scenario-driven training method to understand whether such non-perishable knowledge can be imparted through specially designed incident scenarios, where trainees are presented with and solve investigative challenges in a tool-agnostic manner. We designed two such scenarios based on real-world incidents. Human subjects were recruited from a university's student body for ethnographic study to understand how this training method is received by the subjects and how they perform on such tasks. We collected data from 20 hours of documented training with 25 trainees spread across five sessions. Using grounded-theory, we analyzed the data and uncovered factors that inhibit or promote learning of the investigative thinking skills. Our research combines scenario-based training, ethnographic research, and technical analysis to examine how to best train students in the reasoning skills that industry deems vital to SOCs.
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures
title_cn: 易逝则弃：构建面向非易逝技能的场景化安全培训的民族志研究
abstract_cn: 安全运营中心（SOC）常依赖聚焦所用具体工具与流程的在岗培训。工具的复杂性会盖过底层推理过程，阻碍分析师习得调查技能。我们提出「非易逝知识」概念——独立于工具的调查思维能力。我们设计了场景驱动的培训方法，检验这种非易逝知识能否经由专门设计的事件场景传授：受训者以工具无关的方式面对并解决调查挑战。我们基于真实事件设计了两个这样的场景，从大学学生群体招募受训者开展民族志研究，理解该方法被如何接受、受训者表现如何。我们收集了五次共 25 名受训者、20 小时的记录化培训数据，用扎根理论分析，揭示抑制或促进调查思维能力学习的因素。研究结合场景化培训、民族志方法与技术分析，探讨如何最好地训练业界认为对 SOC 至关重要的推理技能。
summary_cn: 基于两个真实事件的工具无关场景培训的民族志研究（25 名受训者、20 小时）：扎根理论揭示 SOC 调查思维技能的促进与抑制因素。
objective_summary: 以民族志方法评估工具无关场景化培训对 SOC 调查思维技能的传授效果并归纳影响因素。
evidence_note: 25 名受训者、五期 20 小时记录化数据、扎根理论方法规范；学生样本、无对照组、技能提升未做量化前后测。
novelty_note: 「非易逝知识」的概念化与 SOC 培训的民族志证据在该领域较少见。
scope: 结论适用于高校背景受训者与所设计的事件场景。
limitations: 样本为学生而非在职分析师；缺乏量化技能增益；场景仅两个。

title: NetInspector: Measuring and Improving LLM Capabilities for Reliable Intent-Based Networking Policy Generation
abstract: Modern networks are large in scale and heterogeneous in configuration, making manual policy management increasingly impractical. Intent-Based Networking (IBN) addresses this by automating the translation of high-level operator goals into low-level network configurations. Yet existing IBN systems rely on static heuristics and fixed-feature classifiers that generalize poorly to distribution shifts such as new service definitions or evolving phrasing in operator requests. Large Language Models (LLMs), with strong reasoning and translation capabilities demonstrated across many domains, are a natural candidate for IBN policy generation. However, it is unclear whether LLMs can be reliably applied to this task, nor whether their use mitigates or worsens the underlying security risk. In this work, we show that while fine-tuned LLMs excel at intent translation, they exhibit false negative rates when checking whether a proposed intent violates an existing security policy. The root cause is not a lack of logical reasoning capability, but LLMs lack of persistent grounding in network topology and group hierarchy. Motivated by this finding, we introduce NetInspector, a three-layer agentic framework that enforces a verify-then-act protocol, decoupling information retrieval from reasoning so that the LLM focuses on symbolic reasoning while every policy decision is grounded in verifiable network facts retrieved from a live Environment Layer before approval. On NetInspector-Bench, a 2,224-sample synthetic benchmark spanning campus, enterprise, and WAN topologies, NetInspector reduces FNR by over 30\% relative to ungrounded baselines and remains robust under linguistic distribution shifts.
title_cn: NetInspector：测量并提升 LLM 在意图驱动网络策略生成上的可靠性
abstract_cn: 现代网络规模大、配置异构，手工策略管理愈发不现实。意图驱动网络（IBN）以自动化把运营商高层目标翻译为低层网络配置来应对。但现有 IBN 系统依赖静态启发式与固定特征分类器，对新服务定义、运营商措辞演化等分布偏移泛化差。具备强推理与翻译能力的 LLM 是 IBN 策略生成的自然候选，但能否可靠应用、是缓解还是加剧安全风险，并不清楚。我们发现：微调后的 LLM 擅长意图翻译，但在检查某意图是否违反既有安全策略时存在假阴性；根因不是逻辑推理能力不足，而是 LLM 缺乏对网络拓扑与组层级的持久接地。为此我们提出 NetInspector，一个三层智能体框架，强制「先验证后行动」协议：把信息检索与推理解耦，让 LLM 专注符号推理，而每个策略决定都锚定在从在线环境层检索的可验证网络事实上。在覆盖校园/企业/WAN 拓扑的 2,224 样本合成基准 NetInspector-Bench 上，NetInspector 相对未接地基线把 FNR 降低 30% 以上，并在语言分布偏移下保持稳健。
summary_cn: 发现微调 LLM 在「意图是否违反安全策略」检查上假阴性高（根因是缺拓扑接地），提出检索-推理解耦的三层智能体框架：2,224 样本基准上 FNR 降 30%+ 且抗措辞漂移。
objective_summary: 定位 LLM 策略违规检查的假阴性根因并构建接地式智能体框架，以自建基准量化改进与鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 2,224 样本基准、多基线对比、分布偏移实验；合成数据、真实网络验证缺失。
novelty_note: 「先验证后行动」的接地协议与故障根因分析有诊断价值；智能体检索-推理解耦属成熟范式。
scope: 结论适用于可形式化的网络策略域与自建基准覆盖的三类拓扑。
limitations: 合成基准与真实运营商需求的差距；环境层的正确性成为新信任点；LLM 依赖性仍在。

title: Origin Is All You Need: Provenance-Aware Transformers for Structural Trust-Boundary Separation
abstract: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) remains a central safety and security challenge for large language model (LLM) systems because standard transformers lack architectural notion of source authority. Retrieved documents, user inputs, and system instructions are all processed through the same undifferentiated attention mechanism, forcing the model to infer from wording alone what should be obeyed and what should be treated as data. We propose Provenance-Aware Transformers, a provenance-aware defense that makes application-supplied source labels actionable inside the model. Each input token is assigned a ring ID encoding its origin, and the model is augmented with origin embeddings, a learnable origin attention bias, and a learnable origin scale that preserves provenance under normalization. The resulting architecture enforces a structural boundary between authoritative and non-authoritative sources during generation. To instantiate this architecture on released pretrained models, we propose a two-stage fine-tuning pipeline to teach the model origin semantics and task behavior under ring constraints. Evaluation shows that Provenance-Aware Transformers maintain robust resistance to IPI both in-distribution and out-of-distribution while preserving utility comparable to the base pretrained model. More broadly, our work shows that exposing provenance as a first-class architectural signal can shift LLM safety alignment from brittle pattern matching toward explicit trust separation.
title_cn: 来源即所需：在结构上分离信任边界的来源感知 Transformer
abstract_cn: 间接提示注入（IPI）仍是 LLM 系统安全的核心挑战，因为标准 Transformer 在架构上没有「来源权威」概念：检索文档、用户输入与系统指令都经过同一个无差别的注意力机制，模型只能从措辞推断什么该服从、什么该当数据处理。我们提出 Provenance-Aware Transformer：让应用提供的来源标签在模型内部可执行的来源感知防御。每个输入 token 被赋予编码其来源的 ring ID，模型增加来源嵌入、可学习的来源注意力偏置与在归一化下保持来源的可学习缩放。由此架构在生成时强制权威与非权威来源之间的结构边界。为在已发布预训练模型上实例化，我们提出两阶段微调流水线，在 ring 约束下教会模型来源语义与任务行为。评估显示该架构在分布内外都保持对 IPI 的稳健抵抗，同时效用与基础预训练模型相当。更广地，工作表明把来源作为一等架构信号，可以把 LLM 安全对齐从脆弱的模式匹配转向显式信任分离。
summary_cn: 在 Transformer 架构内引入来源 ring ID 与来源注意力偏置，结构性分离权威/非权威输入：分布内外均稳健抗间接提示注入且效用基本不损。
objective_summary: 把来源标签提升为架构级信号的 IPI 防御，含两阶段微调方案与分布内外评估。
evidence_note: 分布内外攻击评估 + 效用对比；模型规模与攻击语料覆盖有限，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把 IPI 防御从提示层/外挂检测推进到注意力架构层是明确的路线级贡献。
scope: 结论适用于可给 token 标注来源的应用形态；对来源不可靠或混淆的场景未覆盖。
limitations: 需微调与架构改动、部署成本高；来源标签自身的正确性成为新信任假设；对跨 ring 复杂攻击未测。

title: Loopjacking: Hijacking Human-in-the-Loop Approval
abstract: Human approval is often treated as the last security boundary before an agent executes a consequential operation. That boundary is only meaningful if the operation presented for review is the operation later authorized or released. We call failures of this binding Loopjacking: a human approves what they understand as operation A, while the implementation uses that decision for a materially different operation B. We distinguish two variants. In a representation-based attack, B is already encoded but omitted or misrepresented at approval time; in a post-approval state-substitution attack, the human sees the correct A and mutable workflow state later replaces it with B. We evaluate a purposive set of released agent products. We reproduce post-approval substitution in seven tested Agno AgentOS releases ending at 3.0.9 and in 12 tested versions of a conditional in-memory LangGraph Agent Server composition ending at 0.14.0. We reproduce representation mismatch in OpenClaw 2026.2.23 and its rejection in 2026.2.24. OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 and 0.22.2 provide a negative control: serialized continuation preserves exact per-call binding and rejects mutated B. These results do not estimate ecosystem prevalence. They show that complete canonical approval rendering and exact use-time comparison, or preventing unauthorized pending-state mutation, block the tested attacks while preserving legitimate execution. We separate this contribution from established work on misleading dialogs, session smuggling, action binding, and authorization continuity.

title_cn: Loopjacking：劫持人机协同审批
abstract_cn: 人的审批常被视为智能体执行重要操作前的最后一道安全边界。该边界只有在「呈请审查的操作就是随后被授权或放行的操作」时才有意义。我们把这类绑定失效称为 Loopjacking：人批准了其所理解的 operation A，实现却把该决定用于实质不同的 operation B。我们区分两个变体：表示型攻击（B 已被编码但在审批时被省略或误呈现）与批准后状态替换攻击（人看到正确的 A，可变工作流状态随后把 A 换成 B）。我们对有意选取的一组已发布智能体产品做评估：在截至 3.0.9 的七个 Agno AgentOS 发行版与某 LangGraph Agent Server 组合的 12 个版本中复现批准后替换；在 OpenClaw 2026.2.23 复现表示失配、2026.2.24 中被修复拒绝；OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0/0.22.2 作为阴性对照——序列化延续保持了精确的逐调用绑定并拒绝被替换的 B。这些结果不估计生态流行度，但表明：完整的规范审批渲染与用时精确比较，或阻止未授权的待定状态变更，即可阻断所测攻击并保留合法执行。
summary_cn: 命名并系统化「人批准 A、执行 B」的审批绑定失效 Loopjacking：在多个已发布智能体框架的 19 个版本中复现，以 OpenAI SDK 为阴性对照并给出修复条件。
objective_summary: 定义审批-执行绑定失效的两类攻击，在多款已发布智能体产品与版本上系统复现并以阴性对照隔离修复条件。
evidence_note: 多产品多版本可复现实验、含阴性对照、证据存档公开；产品为有意选取（purposive），不估计流行度。
novelty_note: 「审批绑定失效」作为一类问题的命名、区分与跨产品验证是新的；与误导对话框等相关工作做了清晰切割。
scope: 结论限于所测产品与版本；不代表生态普遍性（作者明示）。
limitations: 产品选择有偏；攻击以研究者构造为主；长期修复漂移未跟踪。

title: (Don't) Trust, but (Don't) Verify: Developers' Attention to Security in AI-Generated Code
abstract: AI coding assistants are rapidly transforming software development, but are known to produce insecure code. Prior work has measured whether AI-assisted developers produce secure code, but less is known about how they evaluate AI-generated code: whether they can identify vulnerabilities, what cues they use, and how trust shapes their decisions. This evaluation step is foundational to secure development with AI, whether using auto-complete, chat tools, or AI agents. As a first step, we conducted a remote observational study with 100 participants isolating this evaluation stage. Participants were tasked with producing secure and functional code for four C linked-list tasks. For each, participants were able to cycle through five AI-generated suggestions varying in security and functionality, select one, and edit their choice into a final submission. Participants also completed a post-study survey about their decision-making and perception of AI-generated code's security and 23 completed a more in-depth interview.
comment: To appear at IEEE Security and Privacy (S&P) '27
title_cn: (不要)信任，但(不要)验证：开发者对 AI 生成代码安全性的注意力
abstract_cn: AI 编程助手正快速改变软件开发，但已知会产出不安全代码。先行工作测量了 AI 辅助的开发者是否产出安全代码，但对他们如何评估 AI 生成的代码知之甚少：能否识别漏洞、使用哪些线索、信任如何塑造决策。这一评估环节是用 AI 安全开发的基础——无论用自动补全、聊天工具还是 AI 智能体。作为第一步，我们以 100 名参与者做了隔离评估环节的远程观察研究：参与者要为四个 C 链表任务产出安全且功能正确的代码，每题可循环查看五个安全性与功能性各异的 AI 生成建议、选择其一并编辑为最终提交；随后填写关于决策过程及对 AI 代码安全感知的问卷，其中 23 人接受更深入的访谈（IEEE S&P'27）。
summary_cn: 100 人观察研究隔离「开发者评估 AI 生成代码」环节：观察选码与编辑行为、决策线索与信任的作用（IEEE S&P'27，观察研究设计）。
objective_summary: 以隔离评估环节的远程观察研究刻画开发者对 AI 生成代码的安全评估行为与信任机制。
evidence_note: n=100 观察 + 23 访谈、任务设计隔离变量、S&P 录用；单语言（C 链表）任务、行为观察的生态效度有限。
novelty_note: 把研究焦点从「AI 代码是否安全」转到「人如何评估 AI 代码」的环节隔离设计有价值。
scope: 结论适用于 C 语言、链表类小任务与参与开发者的样本构成。
limitations: 任务规模小且虚构；观察环境与真实工作流有差距；自报数据有偏差。

title: ASGARD: Action-Space Guard for UAV Resilience via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) controllers have been recently adopted for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) navigation and control. However, they are susceptible to action-space attacks that overwrite the action commands after the policy generates them and before the actuators execute them. While most existing defenses target attacks on the policy's inputs, those addressing action-space attacks retrain the policy at training time and are not resilient to corrupted actions at runtime. We propose ASGARD, a two-phase teacher-student pipeline for making RL-based UAV control resilient to action-space attacks. In the teacher phase, an encoder combines the UAV's physical state with action-attack-related privileged information to produce an action-attack-aware latent that trains the RL control policy and a monitor that outputs corrected action commands to the actuators. In the student phase, both the encoder and the monitor are trained via supervised learning from their teacher counterparts to run on-board using only the UAV's physical state history. We evaluate ASGARD across attack scenarios targeting different action commands on UAV. We find that ASGARD is resilient to action-space attacks and completes the missions despite the attack. We further find that ASGARD generalizes to unseen attacks and remains resilient against stealthy attacks.
title_cn: ASGARD：经强化学习的无人机动作空间韧性护卫
abstract_cn: 强化学习控制器近期被用于无人机（UAV）导航与控制，但易受动作空间攻击：在策略生成动作之后、执行器执行之前覆写动作命令。现有防御多针对策略输入的攻击；少数处理动作空间攻击的方法在训练期重训策略，无法在运行时抵御被污染的动作。我们提出 ASGARD，一个让基于 RL 的无人机控制对动作空间攻击保持韧性的两阶段师生流水线。教师阶段，编码器把无人机物理状态与动作攻击相关的特权信息结合，产生动作攻击感知的隐表示，用于训练 RL 控制策略与一个向执行器输出校正动作命令的监视器。学生阶段，编码器与监视器经监督学习从教师对应物蒸馏，只用无人机物理状态历史即可在机载运行。在针对不同动作命令的攻击场景上的评估显示：ASGARD 对动作空间攻击保持韧性并在攻击下完成任务；对未见攻击也能泛化，并对隐蔽攻击保持韧性。
summary_cn: 师生蒸馏的无人机动作空间攻击防护 ASGARD：教师用特权信息训练攻击感知监视器，学生仅凭机载状态历史运行，对未见与隐蔽攻击保持韧性。
objective_summary: 提出两阶段师生流水线在运行时校正被攻击的动作命令，多场景验证韧性、泛化与隐蔽攻击鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 多攻击场景与泛化设置评估；仿真为主、缺少统计检验与真实飞行验证，攻击者模型覆盖有限。
novelty_note: 把特权信息蒸馏用于动作空间运行时防护的组合较新；针对输入攻击的防御已有大量工作。
scope: 结论适用于 RL 控制的无人机仿真环境与所设动作覆写攻击模型。
limitations: 仅仿真验证；对执行器物理限制与传感噪声的交互未充分评估；监视器自身的失败模式未分析。

title: TPM-Attest: Hardware-Rooted Integrity Attestation as a Kernel-Level Anti-Cheat Alternative for Linux
abstract: Multiplayer PC gaming on Linux faces a structural problem: the anti-cheat systems that publishers require operate as proprietary Ring 0 kernel modules that are architecturally incompatible with Linux's security model, GPL licensing, and stable ABI guarantees. We argue the right response is not to port these invasive modules to Linux, but to replace them entirely. This paper presents TPM-Attest, a hardware-rooted remote attestation framework that uses the Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0 and the Linux Integrity Measurement Architecture (IMA) to prove, cryptographically, that a client booted cleanly and ran only authorised software -- without any kernel driver, without proprietary code, and without scanning player memory. The system intercepts Epic Online Services (EOS) SDK calls via a userspace LD_PRELOAD hook, gates session access on a live TPM quote bound to a server-issued nonce, and constructs an index-prefixed Merkle tree over the IMA log that is immune to duplicate-leaf collision attacks. Across 500 constructed tamper sessions we achieve a 100% detection rate; incremental leaf caching reduces repeat-attestation latency to under 3 seconds on real TPM 2.0 hardware. A controlled red-team evaluation against a live demo game confirms all four file-backed attack vectors are blocked while precisely characterising the two confirmed bypass conditions. The full implementation is released as open-source software.
authors: A. Yaswanth (1) ((1) GITAM School of Technology
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables
title_cn: TPM-Attest：以硬件为根的完整性证明替代 Linux 内核级反作弊
abstract_cn: Linux 上的多人 PC 游戏面临结构性难题：发行商要求的反作弊系统以专有 Ring 0 内核模块运行，与 Linux 的安全模型、GPL 许可与稳定 ABI 承诺在架构上不兼容。我们主张正确回应不是把这些侵入式模块移植到 Linux，而是彻底替换它们。本文提出 TPM-Attest：一个以 TPM 2.0 与 Linux 完整性度量架构（IMA）为根基的远程证明框架，用密码学证明客户端干净启动且只运行了授权软件——无内核驱动、无专有代码、不扫描玩家内存。系统经用户态 LD_PRELOAD 钩子拦截 Epic Online Services SDK 调用，把会话访问门控在绑定服务器 nonce 的实时 TPM quote 上，并在 IMA 日志上构建带索引前缀的 Merkle 树，可免疫重复叶子碰撞攻击。在 500 个构造的篡改会话上检测率 100%；增量叶子缓存把重复证明延迟在真实 TPM 2.0 硬件上降到 3 秒内。对演示游戏的受控红队评估确认四个文件型攻击向量全部被阻断，并精确刻画了两个已确认的绕过条件。完整实现开源。
summary_cn: 用 TPM 2.0 + IMA 远程证明替代内核级反作弊：500 个篡改会话 100% 检出、重复证明 <3 秒，红队确认阻断全部四个文件型向量并自陈两个绕过条件。
objective_summary: 提出免内核驱动的硬件根完整性证明框架替代专有反作弊，包含真实硬件测量与红队评估。
evidence_note: 真实 TPM 硬件、500 篡改会话、红队评估并诚实披露绕过条件；攻击场景为作者构造、生态代表性有限。
novelty_note: 把远程证明系统性引入游戏反作弊场景并给出可用工程实现；TPM+IMA 组件均为成熟技术。
scope: 结论适用于文件完整性类作弊向量；对内存外挂、GPU 侧作弊与虚拟化作弊不覆盖。
limitations: 绕过条件（作者列出的两类）仍存；运行时内存型作弊不在度量范围；依赖 EOS SDK 钩子的脆弱性。

title: The Right Tool for the Job: On the Selection of Mitigations for GenAI Privacy Threats
abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) has rapidly evolved from an experimental technology into a foundational component of modern software systems. However, as its adoption grows, protecting sensitive personal data becomes increasingly challenging. Specifically, GenAI systems not only amplify traditional privacy threats but also introduce new inference-based risks, such as constructing detailed user profiles from seemingly harmless inputs. In response, privacy threat modeling frameworks are beginning to capture GenAI-specific privacy threats with finer granularity. At the same time, a growing number of mitigation techniques have been proposed to address these threats. However, although knowledge of both threats and mitigations continues to mature, the problem- and solution-space have developed largely independently. This position paper argues that the primary challenge in GenAI privacy engineering is not the lack of knowledge about privacy threats or mitigation techniques, but the missing bridge between them. We decompose this gap into three sub-problems: (i) lack of fine-grained threat-to-mitigation mapping for GenAI systems, (ii) inapplicable solution-space assumptions in the GenAI context, and (iii) prioritization difficulty under GenAI constraints. We derive four recommendations for future mitigation-selection approaches, and outline a suggested approach that extends established threat-to-mitigation mapping methods to GenAI-specific threat characteristics. We propose a research agenda toward more systematic privacy mitigation selection for GenAI-based systems.

title_cn: 合适的工具做合适的事：GenAI 隐私威胁缓解措施的选择
abstract_cn: 生成式 AI 已从实验技术迅速演变为现代软件系统的基础组件。但随着采用增长，保护敏感个人数据愈发困难：GenAI 系统不仅放大传统隐私威胁，还引入新的推断型风险——例如从看似无害的输入构建详细用户画像。隐私威胁建模框架正开始以更细粒度捕捉 GenAI 特有的隐私威胁；与此同时，大量缓解技术被提出。然而，尽管威胁与缓解的知识都在成熟，问题空间与解决方案空间却基本独立发展。本立场论文主张：GenAI 隐私工程的主要挑战不是缺乏威胁或缓解知识，而是二者之间缺失的桥梁。我们把该缺口分解为三个子问题：(i) 缺少面向 GenAI 的细粒度威胁-缓解映射；(ii) 解决方案空间假设在 GenAI 语境下不适用；(iii) GenAI 约束下的优先级排序困难。我们给出对未来缓解选择方法的四条建议，概述一条把既有威胁-缓解映射方法扩展到 GenAI 威胁特征的路径，并提出面向 GenAI 系统更系统的隐私缓解选择研究议程。
summary_cn: 立场论文：GenAI 隐私工程的瓶颈是威胁知识与缓解措施之间缺失的桥梁，分解为映射缺失、假设失配与排序困难三个子问题并给出研究议程。
objective_summary: 论证 GenAI 隐私工程的核心缺口在威胁-缓解映射的缺失，提出子问题分解与研究建议。
evidence_note: 为概念分析与研究议程，无实证评估；对现有威胁框架与缓解措施的梳理有一定支撑。
novelty_note: 威胁-缓解映射的思路沿袭 privacy threat engineering 既有方法，新意在 GenAI 场景化。
scope: 结论适用于 GenAI 系统的隐私工程实践与制度设计。
limitations: 建议的可行性未经验证；威胁与缓解清单的完备性依赖作者判断。

title: dSTAR: Straggler Tolerant and Byzantine Resilient Distributed SGD
abstract: Distributed model training needs to be adapted to challenges such as the straggler effect and Byzantine attacks. When coordinating the training process with multiple computing nodes, ensuring timely and reliable gradient aggregation amidst network and system malfunctions is essential. To tackle these issues, we propose \textit{dSTAR}, a lightweight and efficient approach for distributed stochastic gradient descent (SGD) that enhances robustness and convergence. \textit{dSTAR} selectively aggregates gradients by collecting updates from the first \(k\) workers to respond, filtering them based on deviations calculated using an ensemble median. This method not only mitigates the impact of stragglers but also fortifies the model against Byzantine adversaries. We theoretically establish that \textit{dSTAR} is (\(\alpha, f\))-Byzantine resilient and achieves a linear convergence rate. Empirical evaluations across various scenarios demonstrate that \textit{dSTAR} consistently maintains high accuracy, outperforming other Byzantine-resilient methods that often suffer up to a 40-50\% accuracy drop under attack. Our results highlight \textit{dSTAR} as a robust solution for training models in distributed environments prone to both straggler delays and Byzantine faults.

title_cn: dSTAR：抗掉队者与拜占庭韧性的分布式 SGD
abstract_cn: 分布式模型训练需要应对掉队效应与拜占庭攻击等挑战。在多计算节点协同训练时，保证网络与系统故障下梯度聚合的及时与可靠至关重要。为此我们提出 dSTAR，一个轻量高效的分布式随机梯度下降方法，增强鲁棒性与收敛性。dSTAR 选择性聚合梯度：收集最先响应的 k 个 worker 的更新，并按集成中位数计算的偏差过滤。该方法不仅缓解掉队者影响，还强化模型对拜占庭对手的抵抗。我们在理论上证明 dSTAR 具有 (α, f)-拜占庭韧性并达到线性收敛率。多场景实证评估表明 dSTAR 持续保持高精度，而其他拜占庭韧性方法在攻击下常出现 40–50% 的精度下降。结果表明 dSTAR 是易受掉队延迟与拜占庭故障影响的分布式环境中的稳健训练方案。
summary_cn: 以「最先响应 k 个 worker + 集成中位数过滤」兼顾掉队与拜占庭攻击的分布式 SGD：有 (α,f)-韧性证明与线性收敛率，攻击下避免 40–50% 精度损失。
objective_summary: 提出兼顾掉队者与拜占庭攻击的选择性梯度聚合方法，给出韧性证明与线性收敛率，并在多场景攻击下与既有方法对比。
evidence_note: 理论证明 + 多场景实证，与受攻击基线的精度对比明确；但对手模型与数据集规模的细节有限。
novelty_note: 选择性聚合与中位数过滤均为成熟思路，组合工程良好；理论界为常规形式。
scope: 结论适用于参数服务器式 SGD 与所设拜占庭/掉队模型。
limitations: 「最先响应」可能引入统计偏差；对非独立同分布数据与大规模集群未评估。
